title: Ethnoscience and Scientific–Digital Literacies: A Bibliometric Mapping of Global Research Trends in Science Education (2014–2024)
container-title: Journal of Teaching and Learning
67548a84ff934fe41b4a0bdc2f5a9dfc8525dc49.abstract: Over the past ten years, interest in using ethnoscience approaches in science education has continued to grow, particularly as a learning method relevant to local cultural contexts and capable of supporting the strengthening of scientific and digital literacy. However, research in this field remains scattered across various themes and regions without a comprehensive mapping, necessitating a thorough review to describe the direction and development of research globally. This study aims to conduct a bibliometric analysis of publications related to ethnoscience in science education between 2014 and 2024, focusing on publication trends, dominant themes, key contributors, and collaboration patterns that support the development of scientific and digital literacy based on local culture. A total of 104 documents were analyzed after being filtered from the Scopus database using the keywords “ethnoscience,” “education,” and “learning,” with restrictions on publication year and English language. The data were analyzed using VOSviewer software for keyword mapping and author collaboration networks, supplemented by frequency and field distribution analysis. The research results show that publications have increased significantly since 2017, peaking in 2021, with a continuing upward trend in citations. Dominant themes in the research include science literacy, STEM-based learning, and contextual learning, which are linked to local wisdom values. Although international collaboration remains limited, Indonesia is the most significant contributor globally, with support from several institutions and leading authors. Visualization of the collaboration network shows that most collaborations are local and have not yet formed an integrated global research ecosystem.This study identifies several gaps, including the lack of cross-national research partnerships, the suboptimal use of digital technology in ethnoscience-based learning, and limited development at the higher education level. Research development should focus on transnational collaboration, the integration of innovative technology, and interdisciplinary approaches to expand the impact of ethnoscience in global science education.

title: Transforming Early Childhood Mathematics Learning with Digital Manipulatives: Advancing Technology-Enhanced Cognitive Justice
container-title: Journal of Teaching and Learning
d5029d2288f54a63a06a25d48dae0c29afe8db61.abstract: Transforming early childhood mathematics learning through digital manipulatives can advance technology-enhanced cognitive justice by fostering inclusive, engaging, and equitable experiences. Digital tools such as interactive software, apps, online platforms and games support diverse ways of knowing and enhancing mathematical understanding. However, effective integration is hindered by limited digital access, screen-time management, and teacher preparedness. This study explores (a) how early childhood educators integrate digital manipulatives, (b) the challenges they face, and (c) strategies for effective curriculum incorporation to enhance cognitive justice. Grounded in cognitive justice and constructivist learning theories, this study recognizes diverse epistemologies while promoting active, technology-enhanced learning. Using a hermeneutic phenomenological design, the study collected data from 12 educators sampled through homogeneous purposive sampling via semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and non-participant observations. Findings show teachers use digital manipulatives like YouTube videos and smartboards but struggle with lesson planning and implementation. This highlights gaps in curriculum development for integrating innovative approaches in early mathematics education. Addressing these gaps requires structured teacher training, resource accessibility, and curriculum adaptation to fully harness digital resources to promote technology-enhanced cognitive justice.

title: Digital Bureaucracy and the Paradox of Participation in Indonesia
container-title: JeDEM - eJournal of eDemocracy and Open Government
2237bc7217fc14bf90456363c3013af9ab2af4b8.abstract: This study explores the relation between digital bureaucracy, public engagement, and challenges in Indonesian governance via an ILR consisting of 57 articles indexed in Scopus (2021-2024). Though Indonesia strongly advocates for digital transformation, the results of the study indicate a significant gap. Despite implementing Digital Bureaucracy, Indonesia has been unable to overcome its governance deficit. Indeed, what the study has found is the Paradox of Participation, whereby digital technology aimed at empowering individuals is being used by entrenched patrimonial groups. In other words, without proper institutions, digitalisation becomes a source of oppression in that it helps elites in their practices of digital despotism and surveillance rather than democracy. This indicates that technology merely amplifies the power dynamics already existing in the society. Thus, solving the problem of Challenges for Public Policy Governance will require addressing the underlying extractive nature of the institutions rather than technological problems.

title: AI Adoption in ASEAN Higher Education as a Digital Governance Challenge: A Scoping Review
container-title: JeDEM - eJournal of eDemocracy and Open Government
38c637762cf17ea0c388f33ba5c6ac22b63526fa.abstract: Across the ten ASEAN member states, governments and regional bodies have produced more artificial intelligence (AI) policies for higher education (HE) in three years than the indexed empirical literature has generated to evaluate them. This scoping review treats that policy–evidence mismatch not as an educational-technology problem but as a digital-governance problem: a question of how policy ambition, institutional governance capacity, and educational-informatics infrastructure interact as one socio-technical system. Following Arksey and O’Malley (2005), refined by Levac et al. (2010) and reported under PRISMA-ScR, the Scopus records were screened alongside grey literature from ASEAN, UNESCO, and the World Bank. There are three contributions: we document the mismatch as a structural, not transitional, governance pattern; the Policy–Governance–Informatics (PGI) framework is also proposed, and its falsifiable weakest-layer-binds proposition; it is specified that the theoretical, methodological, and stakeholder gaps in a governance-focused research agenda must be addressed.

title: A retrospective study of smart spot, a Bluetooth low‑energy real‑time location system supporting quality improvement efforts in Uganda
container-title: PLOS Digital Health
ba5e8d1ae8b29f7fdabacc7f25b21fca663ec061.abstract: Real-time location systems track assets and individuals, and in high-income clinical settings, they have improved patient flow. However, their use in low- and middle-income countries remains limited. Smart Spot, a low-cost Bluetooth low-energy real-time location system was integrated within the Smart Triage quality improvement platform in the outpatient department of Uganda Martyrs’ Hospital Ibanda. The primary objective was to evaluate whether Smart Spot data could be used to detect differences in time spent across clinical locations associated with Smart Triage implementation. The secondary objective was to assess the accuracy of Smart Spot data. At triage, children (or their caregivers) received a beacon attached to a lanyard. The beacons tracked patients’ locations throughout their time in the outpatient department. Smart Spot data were collected during a 4‑month baseline phase (pre-Smart Triage) and a 12‑month Smart Triage intervention phase. An algorithm was developed to reduce noise and generate more accurate records of each patient’s journey. The resulting pathways were compared to expected paths to evaluate Smart Spot’s accuracy. The median durations of patient time spent in specific areas were compared between phases using quantile regression. Data cleaning improved the matching to the expected patient flow from 13.0% to 73.1%. Compared with baseline, the median time patients spent in the assessment area decreased by 51.7% (-81.9 min; CI: -95.1 to -68.8), in the emergency room by 69.1% (-44.3 min; CI: -67.7 to -20.8), and total visit duration by 58.2% (-122.9 min; CI: -138.4 to -107.3), all with p-value < 0.001. Real-time location data supported the demonstration of the Smart Triage platform’s benefits. In the cleaned dataset, the intervention phase had shorter total visit time and time reductions within specific areas. Our evaluation demonstrates Smart Spot’s feasibility as an effective data-collection platform for quality improvement and its utility for retrospective analyses in low-resource settings.

title: Cloud-based monitoring and control technology for induction heating digital power supply for intelligent manufacturing
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
980c20362832cb406e2c5b0bbc09ed511d7bd333.abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent manufacturing, induction heating power supplies for efficient and intelligent control play an important role in improving equipment performance. This article proposes a cloud based digital power control strategy for induction heating, which establishes a complete system from the entire process of data collection, modeling, and control system. Sensor network technology is used for real-time sensing of multiple parameters such as voltage, current, and temperature, relying on the industrial Internet of Things to ensure fast data transmission; Introduce cloud platforms into modeling and optimization algorithm processes for predicting power status, adjusting resource allocation, and troubleshooting. Practice has shown that this method has certain advantages in energy efficiency improvement, response lag, and stability, providing an effective method for the intelligent transformation of induction heating equipment and technical support for the application of green and environmentally friendly energy in intelligent manufacturing.

title: A multiscale TCN with efficient channel attention for sensor-based human activity recognition
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
a0a4d254848a15fe8b5aa4184d9c69c549a79701.abstract: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) using inertial sensor signals is a core task for mobile health, intelligent fitness, and wearable sensing. Although recent temporal convolutional network (TCN) and attention-based models have achieved strong results, inertial-sensor-based HAR still faces challenges from temporal-pattern variations across multiple scales, unequal channel contributions, and optimization instability across training runs. This paper proposes a MultiScale- TCN-ECA-Attention framework trained with data augmentation, focal loss, and cosine learning-rate scheduling. The multi-scale temporal convolution branch captures short- and long-range motion patterns, the Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) module recalibrates sensor-channel responses, and temporal attention aggregates discriminative motion segments. Experiments are conducted on two widely used HAR benchmark datasets, PAMAP2 and WISDM. Compared with CNNLSTM, the proposed method improves the macro F1-score by 3.94% on WISDM and 4.55% on PAMAP2. Specifically, the final model achieves mean macro F1-scores of 0.9895 on PAMAP2 and 0.9953 on WISDM. Overall, the proposed method offers an effective and stable framework for IMU-based activity recognition across different sensing settings.

title: A dynamic graph-based time series prediction framework integrating temporal convolutional networks and graph attention mechanisms
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
1f326fedc71a2f3133c72daf0b8f469e2bf63cb8.abstract: This paper addresses the challenge that rise–fall direction prediction in multivariate financial time series is constrained by the difficulty of jointly modeling temporal dependencies and cross-entity correlations. An intelligent algorithm system for multi-stock collaborative prediction is proposed. The system is organized as a computational pipeline, enabling an end-toend learning framework from temporal feature extraction to relational modeling and final decision output, thereby enhancing discriminative capability in complex sequential environments. Methodologically, the system employs a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) as the core encoding module to perform parallel modeling of historical sequences. A dynamic graph is constructed via rolling correlation to capture time-varying relationships among nodes. Furthermore, a Graph Attention mechanism is introduced to adaptively fuse cross-node information, and a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) is utilized for final classification. The overall process forms a unified computational pipeline of “temporal encoding – dynamic graph modeling – attention-based fusion – prediction output,” balancing modeling capacity and computational efficiency. Experimental results on real-world market data demonstrate stable performance improvements. Compared with baseline models, the proposed system achieves an accuracy of 0.5381 and an AUC of 0.5633, while maintaining low variance across multiple random seeds, indicating strong robustness and generalization capability. In conclusion, the proposed intelligent algorithm system effectively integrates temporal modeling with dynamic graph learning, enabling efficient representation of complex multivariate sequences. The framework exhibits strong modularity and scalability, and can be extended to general computational scenarios such as multi-entity time series prediction and anomaly detection.

title: Transformer temporal attention network predicts the early warning time window of mine gas concentration surge
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
d3769ec8a7d03250fbc890dce20c6b2461e7c015.abstract: The early warning of sudden increase of mine gas concentration is related to the safety of mining operation, the effect of ventilation control and the efficiency of disaster response. Combined with the characteristics of low sample proportion of gas surge, strong time series fluctuation, obvious multi-source noise interference and difficult boundary division of time window, this paper constructs a Transformer time series attention network, and extracts multi-source variable features such as gas concentration, wind speed, negative pressure, temperature and humidity and operation status through time series coding. The local trend preserving branch is used to strengthen the expression of short-term climb and critical fluctuation. The multi-head attention mechanism was introduced into the network to assign weights to the key time slices before the surge, and the long and short period feature fusion, prediction and decoding output and sample imbalance loss constraints were combined to improve the recognition accuracy of early warning time window. The experiment is based on the mine comprehensive monitoring platform to obtain 180000 groups of multi-source time series records. The results show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed network reaches 94.2%, the F1 value is 92.8%, and the average error of the time window is 1.7 min under the coal mining working condition. The single inference time under a 60-point window is 13.2 ms, and the delay fluctuation is 0.46 ms. The network can provide stable, fine-grained and deployment value technical support for online early warning of sudden increase in mine gas concentration.

title: Aggregated load forecasting of electric vehicle charging station based on VMD-Attention-BiLSTM hybrid model
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
aaa3b4fae3c834542155b387244af2e3803aa0cc.abstract: Addressing the challenges posed by the strong nonlinearity, non-stationarity, and high randomness o-f the aggregated electric vehicle charging station load, this study introduces a hybrid prediction model called VMD-Attention-BiLSTM. The model employs Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) to decompose the original load sequence into multi-scale stationary modal components. Additionally, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) is utilized to capture bidirectional time series dependencies, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to dynamically enhance key feature weights, leveraging the complementary strengths of these three components. In comparison to conventional single models, this approach eliminates the reliance on human expertise, streamlines complex processing workflows, and surpasses the constraints on prediction accuracy. The findings of this research offer robust technical underpinning for precise load forecasting at charging stations and optimal power grid dispatching.

title: Dual-attention deep learning for wireless channel quality evaluation and joint resource optimization
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
f80553892a18e34e672c9cae77471aea9912fae7.abstract: Reliable evaluation of wireless channel quality is a prerequisite for link adaptation and radio resource management in fifthand sixth-generation (5G/6G) networks. Conventional pilot-based estimators and shallow learning models struggle to jointly capture the spatial, spectral and temporal correlations embedded in high-dimensional channel state information (CSI), which limits their accuracy under fast fading and rich scattering. This paper proposes DACQ-Net, a dual-attention deep learning framework that unifies channel quality evaluation and resource optimization. A multi-scale convolutional stem first extracts local CSI features at three receptive fields; a spatial-spectral attention branch and a temporal attention branch then re-weight informative antenna-subcarrier pairs and time slots respectively, and a cross-domain fusion module aggregates the two views for downstream prediction. A dual head simultaneously regresses the effective signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and classifies the channel quality indicator (CQI), while an attention-guided policy allocates transmit power across subcarriers. Extensive experiments on the DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset, 3GPP CDL channels and a measured campus CSI set show that DACQ-Net attains an SNR prediction root-mean-square error of 1.08 dB and a CQI classification accuracy of 92.6%, reducing the error of a strong Transformer baseline by 17.6%. The attention-guided allocation reaches 95.5% of the water-filling upper bound in spectral efficiency, outperforming a greedy heuristic by 14.8%. Ablation studies confirm that both attention branches and the multi-scale stem contribute complementary gains. The results indicate that dual-attention modeling is an effective and lightweight route toward intelligent channel quality evaluation and optimization.

title: An industrial information engineering-oriented LSTM-attention online soft-sensing method based on multisource asynchronous data for cigarette rolling production lines
container-title: International Conference on Wireless, Optical Communication, and Information Engineering (WOCIE 2026)
e8f3fbc98b7559833f62584d8555ec5956f6dda7.abstract: Under the industrial information engineering environment, cigarette rolling production lines generate multi-source asynchronous data from equipment control units, airflow conveying modules, material supply devices, and offline quality detection platforms. However, the weight quality of rolled cigarettes is difficult to be continuously measured online because of the time delay of detection results and the inconsistent sampling frequency of equipment parameters. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an LSTM-Attention online soft-sensing method based on multi-source asynchronous equipment data. First, parameters such as garniture tape height, VE negative pressure, needle roller speed, small fan positive pressure, reclaimed tobacco flow rate, and cigarette weight detection results are aligned by a unified timestamp. Then, a sliding-window reconstruction method is used to transform discrete production records into industrial time-series samples. On this basis, a two-layer LSTM network is constructed to extract short-term disturbances and long-term evolution features, and a multi-head Attention mechanism is introduced to identify the dynamic contribution of key process variables. Experimental results on 12,000 valid samples show that the MAE, RMSE, MAPE, and R² of the proposed method reach 0.154 g, 0.213 g, 1.98%, and 0.951, respectively. In the online soft-sensing test, the average soft-sensing response time is 42 ms, the data acquisition integrity reaches 98.7%, and the online soft-sensing stability reaches 96.4%.The proposed method provides an information-engineering-based solution for real-time quality perception and online soft measurement in cigarette rolling production lines.

title: La prueba digital en los procesos judiciales en México: objeción, incorporación, autenticación, impugnación y valoración de la evidencia electrónica
CONTROLES PARENTAIS E AUTONOMIA PROGRESSIVA: CRITÉRIOS JURÍDICOS PARA IMPLEMENTAR O ECA DIGITAL
container-title: IX Seven International Multidisciplinary Congress
efda64c33fb774336bb63b033bb57ce1f09366a8.abstract: Uma lei que manda respeitar a autonomia progressiva de crianças e adolescentes precisa dizer como se gradua essa autonomia. Este artigo examina o que o Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente oferece para essa tarefa. Foram articuladas três camadas independentes: o texto da Lei nº 15.211, de 17 de setembro de 2025, e da Lei nº 8.069, de 13 de julho de 1990, obtido em duas fontes oficiais para cada diploma e comparado palavra por palavra; a Pesquisa Nacional por Amostra de Domicílios Contínua de 2025; e a leitura individual de 12 registros bibliográficos recuperados por um funil declarado. A lei de 2025 tem 7050 palavras, emprega a expressão autonomia progressiva 2 vezes sem defini-la, não emprega nenhuma vez a expressão controle parental e fixa apenas 2 limiares numéricos de idade em todo o texto. Em 76,5% das ocorrências, ela trata criança e adolescente como um bloco único, contra 21,3% no Estatuto de 1990. Entre os brasileiros, 84,4% dos que têm de 10 a 13 anos e 94,8% dos que têm de 14 a 19 usaram a internet nos três meses de referência, e nenhuma faixa etária publicada tem fronteira no único limiar interno da lei. Dos 12 registros lidos, 2 propõem ou avaliam um critério operacional para graduar a supervisão.

title: LOW-CARBON ENERGY MODERNIZATION OF CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE IN THE DIGITAL ECONOMY: TRANSITIONING WATER UTILITIES TO INDUSTRY 4.0/5.0 IN WARTIME
НИЗЬКОВУГЛЕЦЕВА ЕНЕРГЕТИЧНА МОДЕРНІЗАЦІЯ КРИТИЧНОЇ ІНФРАСТРУКТУРИ В РАМКАХ ЦИФРОВОЇ ЕКОНОМІКИ: ПЕРЕХІД ВОДОПРОВІДНО-КАНАЛІЗАЦІЙНОГО ГОСПОДАРСТВА ДО ІНДУСТРІЇ 4.0/5.0 У ВІЙСЬКОВИЙ ЧАС
container-title: РОЗВИТОК МІСТА
5611d5b7d99575337fe8699c659c38bc1d858d42.abstract: The article substantiates strategic priorities, organizational-economic, and financial mechanisms for the low-carbon energy modernization of water utilities as critical infrastructure assets in Ukraine. It is demonstrated that, under wartime conditions, power grid capacity shortages, and persistent blackout risks, improving internal energy efficiency and enhancing utility autonomy are key drivers of national security, community viability, and achieving national decarbonization targets. Based on an analysis of cost structures and load profiles, it is identified that the primary share of energy consumption in water utilities is concentrated at the water intake and distribution stages, justifying prioritizing investment in the energy modernization of these operational steps. Key technical-economic inefficiencies and energy-related economic risks facing water utilities during wartime are systematized. It is identified that legacy Industry 3.0 operational approaches (relying on mechanical valve throttling) lead to excessive electricity expenditures, whereas the deployment of Industry 4.0 and 5.0 digital tools (VSDs, SCADA systems, and IoT sensors) yields a 15–30% reduction in operating costs. A roadmap for deploying solar photovoltaic power plants at water utility sites integrated into internal energy management systems is proposed. Relying exclusively on municipal budgets for funding such projects is shown to be impractical; instead, financial models are formulated that combine municipal co-financing (10–15% of CAPEX), green loans from international financial institutions (EBRD, EIB, NEFCO), non-repayable grants, and PPAs with private investors. A conceptual framework for the organizational-economic support mechanism for energy modernization is developed to optimize capital costs and build green resilience within the municipal sector. It is proven that decarbonization, energy security, and operational resilience of water utilities represent mutually reinforcing objectives. The practical value of the findings lies in establishing a decision-support system for municipalities. Future research may focus on leveraging Industry 5.0 tools, artificial intelligence, and industrial energy storage systems to further support the energy modernization of water utilities.

title: COMPETENCY PROFILE OF AN HR MANAGER IN A FOOD INDUSTRY ENTERPRISE UNDER CONDITIONS OF DIGITAL AND INTELLECTUAL TRANSFORMATION
КОМПЕТЕНТНІСНИЙ ПРОФІЛЬ HR-МЕНЕДЖЕРА ПІДПРИЄМСТВА ХАРЧОВОЇ ПРОМИСЛОВОСТІ В УМОВАХ ЦИФРОВОЇ ТА ІНТЕЛЕКТУАЛЬНОЇ ТРАНСФОРМАЦІЇ
container-title: РОЗВИТОК МІСТА
05afa266b202f6458d670ee9eb7b41071b9c2bca.abstract: The article examines the significant transformation of the HR manager’s role, from performing predominantly administrative personnel functions to strategic human capital management and ensuring enterprise resilience. This issue is particularly relevant for food industry enterprises, whose operations are characterized by high requirements for product quality and safety, technological modernization, a shortage of qualified personnel, the need to comply with international standards, and rapid adaptation to changes in the external environment. The purpose of the study is to develop a modern competency profile of an HR manager in a food industry enterprise, taking into account transformations in the content of professional activities and new requirements for personnel management. The feasibility of applying a competency-based approach that integrates professional knowledge, practical skills, managerial abilities, digital competencies, personal qualities, and value orientations is substantiated. A competency profile structure for an HR manager is proposed, comprising six interrelated blocks: strategic and business, professional and functional, digital and analytical, intellectual and innovative, leadership and communication, and adaptive and humanistic competencies. The content of the key competencies within each block is defined, including HR strategy, business thinking, recruitment, talent management, HRIS, HR analytics, the use of artificial intelligence, data-driven decision-making, critical and systems thinking, learning agility, leadership, emotional intelligence, coaching, professional ethics, human-centeredness, social responsibility, stress resilience, and change management. It is demonstrated that the proposed model combines traditional professional and functional requirements for HR managers with competencies shaped by digitalization, intellectualization, and the instability of the modern business environment. The industry-specific characteristics of the profile are determined by requirements for food safety, quality, environmental responsibility, occupational safety, professional development, and corporate culture. The proposed competency profile can be used for professional selection, assessment, development, and training of HR managers in food industry enterprises.

title: Confidence-Calibrated Temporal Attention Framework for Interpretable Video Anomaly Detection
3e842b89d60a74e4368f797645fa604c5353952d.abstract: Abstract Video anomaly detection in surveillance environments is challenged by ambiguous event boundaries, complex scenes, and unreliable predictions. Existing methods mainly focus on anomaly scoring without modeling prediction confidence or interpretability. This paper proposes a confidence-guided spatiotemporal framework for interpretable anomaly detection. The method introduces a confidence calibrated temporal attention mechanism to jointly model anomaly likelihood and prediction reliability, enabling distinction between reliable and uncertain detections. It further employs uncertainty-aware attention to adaptively aggregatetemporal features for robust anomaly localization. A confidence estimation module captures uncertainty, while temporal consistency stabilizes predictions. An interpretability module highlights salient spatiotemporal regions contributingto anomaly decisions. Experiments on UCSD, Avenue, ShanghaiTech, and UCFCrime datasets achieve 95.1%, 89.3%, 87.3%, and 84.7% AUC, respectively, with an average improvement of 2.8% over baselines and 58 FPS inference speed. These results demonstrate that confidence-aware and interpretable modeling improves the reliability and applicability of video anomaly detection systems.

title: Pengaruh Integrasi Media Konkret-Digital Interaktif terhadap Hasil Belajar Penjumlahan Pengurangan Kelas V
container-title: Jurnal Ilmiah Profesi Pendidikan
f3bec24880af9fa088ef95a2110d189070d8ff1d.abstract: Pembelajaran matematika pada materi penjumlahan dan pengurangan bilangan cacah memerlukan pengalaman belajar yang membantu murid menghubungkan konsep dengan situasi nyata. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui perbedaan hasil belajar penjumlahan, pengurangan bilangan cacah antara murid yang memperoleh pembelajaran dengan integrasi media konkret dan digital interaktif dan murid yang memperoleh pembelajaran tanpa integrasi media tersebut. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain kuasi-eksperimen Nonequivalent Control Group Design. Penelitian melibatkan 54 murid kelas V SD Negeri 006 Samarinda Ulu, terdiri atas 27 murid kelas VB sebagai kelompok eksperimen dan 27 murid kelas VA sebagai kelompok kontrol. Kelompok eksperimen menggunakan uang mainan, kartu nilai tempat, miniatur kasir, jenis barang beserta harga, dan PowerPoint interaktif melalui pembelajaran berbasis masalah serta simulasi “Pasar Murah”. Data dikumpulkan melalui pretest dan posttest. Analisis menggunakan SPSS 27 data meliputi statistik deskriptif, uji normalitas, uji homogenitas, Mann–Whitney U sebagai uji hipotesis untuk melihat peningkatan. Hasil menunjukkan rata-rata posttest kelompok eksperimen sebesar 81,48, sedangkan kelompok kontrol sebesar 62,22. Uji Mann–Whitney U menghasilkan U = 142,500 dengan p < 0,001. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan terdapat perbedaan pengaruh hasil belajar yang signifikan antara kedua kelompok. Integrasi media konkret dan digital interaktif memberikan pengalaman belajar yang menghubungkan pemahaman konkret, visualisasi digital, dan penerapan konsep matematika dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Temuan ini mendukung penggunaan media terpadu dalam pembelajaran matematika di sekolah.

title: Mil Aulas como estrategia pedagógica para fortalecer las competencias digitales en docentes de bachillerato
Mil Aulas as a pedagogical strategy to strengthen digital competences among high school teachers
container-title: Revista Científica Ciencia y Método
18af8fb9910de58dd71074332c731862f82034e4.abstract: Insufficient training in teachers’ digital competencies limits the pedagogical integration of technological tools into educational practices, especially in rural contexts. The objective of the study was to evaluate the contribution of the Mil Aulas platform to strengthening the digital competencies of high school teachers. A quantitative study was conducted using a quasi-experimental design with pretest and posttest measurements, involving 15 teachers from a rural educational institution in Ecuador’s Costa region. A 10-item structured questionnaire using a Likert scale, based on the DigCompEdu framework, was employed. The data were analyzed using SPSS, yielding a reliability coefficient of α = 0.811. The Shapiro-Wilk test yielded a p-value of 0.523, while Student’s t-test for paired samples revealed statistically significant differences between the two measurements (p < 0.001). These results suggest that training through Mil Aulas contributed to strengthening teachers’ digital competencies; however, the sample size limits the generalizability of the findings. It is concluded that Mil Aulas constitutes a promising pedagogical alternative for strengthening digital competencies and promoting the integration of technologies into educational practices.

title: Beyond Inflammation: Fatigue, Functional Impairment, and Individualized Rehabilitation Strategies in Systemic Autoimmune Diseases
container-title: IECCMEXICO
aee049bbc777e7cbeb49dc9f0fc75d237a56dc29.abstract: Fatigue and functional disability are among the most persistent and debilitating manifestations of systemic autoimmune diseases, frequently affecting physical performance, occupational participation, independence, and health-related quality of life. Although advances in immunomodulatory therapies have improved inflammatory disease control, many patients continue to experience substantial fatigue and functional limitations that cannot be explained exclusively by conventional measures of disease activity. This narrative review aimed to analyze the relationship between persistent inflammation, fatigue, and functional disability in rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, primary Sjögren’s syndrome, and systemic sclerosis, emphasizing clinical assessment and personalized rehabilitation strategies. A descriptive, analytical, and integrative approach was applied to 20 selected scientific publications, including clinical trials, observational studies, systematic reviews, and international recommendations, with particular consideration of Latin American contributions. The reviewed evidence identified chronic pain, sleep disturbances, psychological factors, physical deconditioning, and accumulated disease-related damage as relevant determinants of fatigue and functional impairment. Standardized patient-reported instruments, inflammatory disease activity indices, and objective functional assessments provided complementary information for characterizing symptom burden. Rehabilitation studies documented improvements in selected measures of exercise tolerance, muscular performance, fatigue, and quality of life following structured aerobic exercise, resistance training, and supervised or home-based interventions. Latin American investigations contributed evidence concerning physical rehabilitation, occupational impairment, and clinical heterogeneity across autoimmune populations. Nevertheless, variability in study designs, assessment instruments, and intervention protocols limited direct comparisons and prevented definitive conclusions regarding the superiority of individual rehabilitation approaches. The findings support an integrated clinical framework combining inflammatory disease management, multidimensional fatigue assessment, and individualized rehabilitation. Further multicenter investigations with standardized outcomes and long-term follow-up are needed to optimize functional recovery and improve patient-centered management in systemic autoimmune diseases.

title: Early-Stage Co-Creation and Human-Centered Development of Digital Therapeutics for Cognitive Rehabilitation in Early Neurocognitive Disorders: Convergent Mixed Methods Study
container-title: Journal of Medical Internet Research
53541a4cf645a31d38e8d41cad81f50e31f7c722.abstract: Abstract Background Subjective cognitive decline (SCD) and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) represent critical windows for early neurocognitive intervention, although access to timely, personalized rehabilitation remains limited. Digital health technologies offer opportunities to deliver scalable and individualized cognitive care; however, their successful implementation depends on an understanding of users’ needs, expectations, and barriers. Within a human-centered design (HCD) framework, actively involving end users during the earliest stages of development is essential to ensure that digital rehabilitation is acceptable, usable, and responsive to real-world rehabilitation needs. Objective This study explores the experiences, rehabilitation needs, perceptions, and challenges of individuals with SCD and MCI regarding cognitive telerehabilitation. The findings are intended to inform the early-stage co-creation and human-centered development of digital rehabilitation solutions. Methods The study is framed within an HCD perspective to inform the user-centered development of digital rehabilitation solutions. A convergent mixed methods design was adopted to integrate quantitative assessments with qualitative interviews. The semistructured interview explored 4 thematic domains: neurocognitive abilities, network support, user experience and engagement, and digital divide. Twenty-three individuals with SCD or MCI completed the interview together with measures including the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), Cognitive Failures Questionnaire (CFQ), and an ad hoc Technological Expertise questionnaire. Qualitative interview data were analyzed using directed content analysis based on 4 predefined thematic domains by 2 independent raters, with interrater agreement assessed using Cohen κ. Qualitative and quantitative findings were subsequently integrated through exploratory Mann-Whitney U tests. Results Twenty-three participants (n=16 female participants; mean age 74.3, SD 7.35 y) were included. Participants reported preserved cognitive performance (MoCA: mean 24.9, SD 3.23), low-to-moderate perceived cognitive difficulties (CFQ: mean 22.4, SD 9.48), and moderate technological familiarity. Qualitative findings revealed memory (n=12, 52.2%), attention/executive (n=6, 26.1%), and language (n=4, 17.4%) difficulties during everyday activities, together with widespread use of compensatory strategies. Participants also described emotional vulnerability, social withdrawal, and feelings of misunderstanding, as well as delayed rehabilitation access despite reporting cognitive concerns to health care professionals. Although most participants had limited prior knowledge of telerehabilitation, they expressed a positive attitude toward home-based rehabilitation, valuing its convenience, flexibility, autonomy, and accessibility when appropriate technological and clinical support was available. Concerns mainly related to limited supervision, technical barriers, and digital literacy. Mixed methods integration showed that perceived technology-related barriers were associated with lower technological competence (median 1.88, IQR 1.69‐2.56 vs median 3.06, IQR 2.75‐3.59; P =.002), while no other significant differences emerged. Conclusions These findings highlight that effective digital rehabilitation should be developed through iterative, user-informed HCD processes that simultaneously address cognitive, emotional, social, and technological dimensions of early neurocognitive decline. Integrated findings highlight the importance of addressing individual needs and incorporating users’ perspectives from the earliest design phases to support usable, engaging, and accessible digital rehabilitation solutions.

title: SISTEMAS ERP COMO SUPORTE À TRANSFORMAÇÃO DIGITAL: IMPACTOS NA EFICIÊNCIA OPERACIONAL E NO CONTROLE GERENCIAL EM PEQUENAS EMPRESAS
container-title: Revista Acadêmica Online
9f97904835eee64fc5a3835fd9f43abf5369ac81.abstract: A transformação digital tem se tornado fundamental para a modernização das pequenas empresas, diante da necessidade de otimizar processos, reduzir falhas operacionais e aprimorar o controle gerencial. Nesse contexto, os sistemas Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) destacam-se por integrar informações e automatizar atividades organizacionais, embora sua implementação ainda apresente desafios relacionados aos custos, à capacitação dos usuários e à resistência às mudanças. O objetivo deste estudo foi compreender como os sistemas ERP atuam como suporte à transformação digital em pequenas empresas, considerando seus impactos na eficiência operacional e no controle gerencial. Realizou-se uma pesquisa de abordagem qualitativa, de natureza básica e objetivos exploratório e descritivo, desenvolvida por meio de uma revisão integrativa da literatura. A busca bibliográfica contemplou bases de dados científicas, como Google Acadêmico, SciELO, Biblioteca Virtual em Saúde, Scopus e Web of Science. Os resultados da análise dos 13 estudos evidenciaram que os sistemas ERP contribuem para a integração de processos, a centralização de dados, a automação de tarefas, a redução de retrabalho e a melhoria da qualidade das informações utilizadas na tomada de decisões. Também foram identificados benefícios relacionados ao acompanhamento de indicadores, ao controle financeiro e à coordenação das atividades organizacionais. Entretanto, verificou-se que esses resultados dependem do planejamento da implementação, da disponibilidade de recursos, da adequação do sistema às necessidades empresariais e da capacitação dos colaboradores. Concluiu-se que os sistemas ERP constituem ferramentas estratégicas para a transformação digital das pequenas empresas, favorecendo a eficiência operacional e o fortalecimento do controle gerencial, desde que sua adoção seja acompanhada de planejamento e gestão adequados.

title: Implementación de la plataforma digital de inteligencia artificial Microsoft Copilot en la comprensión lectora del idioma inglés en estudiantes de primer nivel del programa de Física
Implementation of artificial intelligence digital platform Microsoft Copilot in reading comprehension of english language at first level students of the Physics program
container-title: Sage Sphere of Technology, Sciences, Discoveries And Society
450be1227edb8aef6504db103dd7b8a6c5e33f35.abstract: Introducción: La inteligencia artificial generativa puede apoyar la comprensión lectora en inglés mediante explicaciones de vocabulario, resúmenes y preguntas guiadas. La evidencia sobre Microsoft 365 Copilot en la educación superior latinoamericana sigue siendo limitada. Este estudio examinó la comprensión lectora y las percepciones y experiencias de estudiantes de Física de la ESPOCH, Ecuador. Metodología: Se aplicó un enfoque mixto secuencial explicativo con un componente preexperimental de un solo grupo, con pretest y postest, en 23 estudiantes de primer nivel durante ocho sesiones semanales. Se utilizaron una prueba de lectura de 30 ítems, un cuestionario Likert de 20 ítems y entrevistas semiestructuradas. Resultados: La media aumentó de 14,57 (DE = 2,35) a 20,74 (DE = 3,00), con una ganancia de 6,17 puntos, t(22) = 18,03, p < 0,001 y dz de Cohen = 3,76. La percepción global fue favorable (M = 81,78/100; DE = 7,31) y superó el valor de referencia de 60 (Wilcoxon W = 276; p < 0,001). Las entrevistas destacaron el apoyo al vocabulario, la interpretación, la confianza y la participación, junto con dificultades al formular instrucciones, problemas de conexión y preocupaciones sobre dependencia de la IA. Conclusiones: Copilot se percibió como recurso complementario útil. La mejora observada coincidió con la intervención, pero la ausencia de grupo de control impide establecer causalidad.

title: Digital innovation and public acceptance of nuclear energy in the green transition
container-title: Environmental Research: Energy
8707941fa62d8f70a384220f0d3193a412255709.abstract: Abstract Public acceptance is widely regarded as a binding constraint on the contribution of nuclear energy to the green transition, yet claims that digital innovation will ease this constraint have rarely been examined against social science evidence. This topical review asks under what conditions digital innovation in nuclear energy systems, in particular digital twins, artificial intelligence (AI)-based predictive maintenance and the digitally supported design, manufacture and operation of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs), can contribute to public acceptance of nuclear energy. The analysis draws on five strands of scholarship that are seldom brought into contact with the technical literature: risk perception research, cultural theory of risk, the deficit and engagement models of science communication, the social licence to operate, and socio-technical transitions theory, which serves as the integrating framework. Reading techno-optimistic claims through these lenses, the review identifies three structural barriers: a cybersecurity paradox, whereby the connectivity that enables digital safety functions simultaneously expands the attack surface; an economic gap, specific to SMRs, whereby projected cost reductions rest on serial-production assumptions that recent project experience has not supported; and a transparency fallacy, whereby information disclosure is expected to build trust although meta-analytic evidence links the benefit and risk perceptions associated with acceptance to trust rather than to knowledge. These barriers are argued to interact: cyber incidents could act as trust-destroying signal events, cost failures could undermine perceived institutional competence, and one-way transparency tools leave procedural justice concerns unaddressed. The review concludes that digital innovation is more likely to support acceptance when it is embedded in genuinely participatory engagement, when institutions demonstrably manage the new risks digitalisation creates, when economic claims are validated rather than promised, and when regulatory frameworks confer procedural legitimacy. Absent these conditions, digitalisation risks reproducing deficit-model assumptions that acceptance research has long found wanting.

title: Lightweight 3D LiDAR Rubber Tree Detection with Knowledge Distillation and Efficient Attention
container-title: Engineering Research Express
edeb869bb9aea38181123ebb0891d9514de6a1ca.abstract: Abstract This study investigates a compact LiDAR-based detector for rubber-tree trunk detection using a controlled simulated plantation benchmark together with two real-world forest-domain evaluations. Starting from MobilePIXOR, the backbone is modified with LiDAR-Adapted Omni-Scale Blocks (LAOSB) to strengthen multi-scale BEV feature extraction while reducing model size and computational cost. The simulation data are used as a controlled within-domain benchmark rather than as a scene-disjoint test of real-world generalization. Across three random seeds, LAOSB improves AP50:95 from 0.713 ± 0.001 to 0.732 ± 0.010 while reducing the parameter count from 0.596M to 0.404M and the computational cost from 12.91 to 11.23 GFLOPs.&#xD;&#xD;Further structured depth reduction produces the S3 Hard student, which achieves 0.735 ± 0.003 AP50:95 with 0.246M parameters and 10.94 GFLOPs, while LCB-BA Combined KD attains 0.738 ± 0.005 with 0.248M parameters and 11.05 GFLOPs. Matched hard-supervision and distillation controls show that the contribution of knowledge distillation is small and configuration-dependent. On the 354-frame acquisition-disjoint DigiForests evaluation, S3 Hard reaches 0.2874 ± 0.0172 AP50 and 0.0853 ± 0.0077 AP50:95 over 3,707 stems within 12 m. On the auxiliary manually annotated 50-frame FinnWoodlands pilot, S3 Hard reaches 0.2090 ± 0.0758 AP50 and 0.0720 ± 0.0265 AP50:95 over 903 trunks within 12 m, while visibility-stratified analysis shows a pronounced degradation under partial and heavy occlusion. Controlled point-dropout evaluation further indicates substantial operating-point sensitivity as LiDAR sparsity increases. DigiForests is treated as the primary external quantitative benchmark, while FinnWoodlands provides supporting manually annotated box-level and occlusion evidence; neither external evaluation is interpreted as direct scene-disjoint validation on natural rubber plantations.

title: O Jogo da Lua
container-title: Extensão Tecnológica: Revista de Extensão do Instituto Federal Catarinense
8f755687c94adda036ef1b144a9af2ff88bcae1b.abstract: Este trabalho apresenta um relato de experiência decorrente de dois projetos desenvolvidos simultaneamente ao longo do ano de 2025;um de extensão e outro de natureza mista (ensino e extensão). As atividades foram realizadas no Instituto Federal Catarinense, campus Concórdia (IFC) e em escolas da região, com o objetivo de promover a divulgação do Instituto e apoiar o ensino de Física e Astronomia. O foco deste relato é o Jogo da Lua, um recurso virtual desenvolvido em linguagem Python para aplicação em sala de aula, alinhado às metodologias ativas de aprendizagem. O jogo aborda temas como exploração espacial, características físicas, fenômenos naturais e aspectos históricos da Lua. Sua estrutura baseia-se em uma roleta digital com sete setores, totalizando setenta questões de verdadeiro ou falso, além de quatro questões dissertativas, denominadas Momento Bônus. O recurso foi continuamente aprimorado e a versão final foi aplicada a duas turmas do ensino técnico integrado ao médio do IFC, com pré-testes e pós-testes. Os resultados indicaram aumento significativo nos acertos, além de maior engajamento discente, estímulo à argumentação científica, intensificação da interação em sala de aula e desenvolvimento de habilidades cognitivas e sociais.

title: Aprendizaje socioemocional y bienestar estudiantil en la era digital
Social emotional learning and student well being in the digital age
container-title: Sage Sphere Multidisciplinary Studies
e8a2edb33b1e648701d2e7bf12a916542ddc0a6a.abstract: El objetivo de esta investigación fue analizar los vínculos entre el aprendizaje socioemocional y el bienestar estudiantil en contextos educativos mediados por tecnologías digitales. Se desarrolló una revisión integrativa de literatura con enfoque cualitativo y alcance descriptivo. El corpus documental quedó conformado por 15 publicaciones académicas diferentes, difundidas entre 2021 y 2026, que abordaron las competencias socioemocionales, el bienestar en experiencias educativas o las condiciones de implementación de tecnologías para el aprendizaje. La información se organizó mediante una síntesis temática de las competencias socioemocionales, los factores de bienestar y la mediación pedagógica digital. Los trabajos examinados coinciden en señalar la importancia de la autorregulación emocional, la empatía, la interacción social y el acompañamiento docente. La evidencia sobre estrategias de aprendizaje activo en modalidad combinada aporta ejemplos concretos de desarrollo de habilidades socioemocionales y participación estudiantil. También se identificaron factores contextuales que pueden condicionar esos resultados, como el acceso tecnológico, el clima educativo y la calidad de la interacción. Se concluye que integrar apoyos socioemocionales en el diseño pedagógico digital puede contribuir a experiencias educativas más participativas y cuidadosas del bienestar. Dada la diversidad metodológica de las publicaciones, los hallazgos se interpretan como asociaciones y orientaciones pedagógicas, no como demostraciones causales generalizables.

title: O ENSINO DE LÍNGUA PORTUGUESA NAS MARGENS DA CULTURA DIGITAL: UM ESTUDO COMPARATIVO EM ESCOLAS DE CAMETÁ-PA
container-title: Artefactum - revista de estudos interdisciplinares
d844b9bc667e01b28ce3e4fb66b42a1a5ece317c.abstract: A inserção da cultura digital no ensino de Língua Portuguesa revela profundas assimetrias materiais, especialmente no contexto da Amazônia Tocantina. Este artigo tem como objetivo analisar as contradições do uso de tecnologias digitais na educação, por meio de um estudo comparativo entre duas escolas em Cametá-PA: a EMEIF Professora Maria Nadir Figueira Valente (zona urbana) e a EMEIF Demóstenes Raniere (zona rural). A fundamentação teórica baseia-se no materialismo histórico-dialético e na pedagogia dos multiletramentos, mobilizando autores para investigar como a plataformização afeta o trabalho docente e a apropriação crítica das linguagens. A metodologia caracteriza-se por uma revisão qualitativa e análise bibliográfica pautada nas diretrizes locais. Os resultados preliminares indicam que a infraestrutura urbana não garante uma educação emancipatória, frequentemente reproduzindo lógicas mercadológicas, enquanto a exclusão digital na zona rural atua como um mecanismo deliberado de isolamento. Conclui-se que a práxis pedagógica precisa transcender o fetiche tecnológico, adotando táticas de resistência que reintegrem a tecnologia como força produtiva para a classe trabalhadora.

title: INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL E APRENDIZAGEM NA EDUCAÇÃO BÁSICA: CONTRIBUIÇÕES DO NOVO CONEXIONISMO PARA A CULTURA DIGITAL
container-title: Artefactum - revista de estudos interdisciplinares
29f387a493d6dedcdc06a43a351733fb3b1628a8.abstract: O avanço da Inteligência Artificial (IA) tem ampliado debates acerca dos processos de aprendizagem e dos desafios educacionais decorrentes da crescente presença das tecnologias digitais na sociedade contemporânea. Nesse contexto, compreender como os sistemas inteligentes aprendem e de que forma esse conhecimento pode contribuir para os processos formativos torna-se uma questão relevante para a Educação Básica. Este artigo tem como objetivo analisar, à luz do novo conexionismo, como ocorre a aprendizagem em sistemas de Inteligência Artificial e discutir suas implicações para a aprendizagem na Educação Básica. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de abordagem qualitativa, fundamentada principalmente nas discussões apresentadas por Lefrançois sobre o novo conexionismo, articuladas às diretrizes da Base Nacional Comum Curricular para Computação (BNCC Computação) e aos estudos sobre educação e cultura digital. A análise teórica indica que os sistemas de IA aprendem por meio da reorganização das conexões entre unidades de processamento inspiradas nas redes neurais humanas, enquanto a aprendizagem dos estudantes envolve processos mais amplos relacionados à construção de significados, às interações sociais, à cultura e ao desenvolvimento de valores. Conclui-se que a Inteligência Artificial pode potencializar os processos educativos quando integrada de forma crítica, ética e pedagogicamente intencional, fortalecendo o pensamento crítico, a autonomia e a participação responsável dos estudantes na cultura digital.

title: SUSTAINABILITY-ORIENTED INNOVATION IN HIGHER EDUCATION: ORGANIZATIONAL PROCESSES AND DIGITAL-SUSTAINABILITY ARTICULATIONS IN A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
container-title: Artefactum - revista de estudos interdisciplinares
ed232bf30e68237969b88a922fed95906ae1fea2.abstract: Higher education institutions are increasingly expected to develop innovations capable of addressing environmental and social challenges while simultaneously incorporating digital technologies, new forms of coordination, and more intensive relationships with external stakeholders. This article examines how the literature has investigated the development of sustainability-oriented innovation processes in higher education institutions and, where empirically relevant, how the digital dimension is articulated with these processes. A systematic literature review was conducted and reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020, using three complementary search strategies in the Web of Science: sustainability-oriented innovation and higher josiane@uenp.edu.br education; a sensitivity search incorporating processual and organizational terms; and Twin Transition and higher education. The qualitative synthesis was organized around analytical dimensions concerning the origin and direction of initiatives, the actors and capabilities involved, processes of development and implementation, forms of evaluation and continuity, and the articulation between sustainability and digitalization. The findings indicate that sustainability becomes more substantive when it influences problem definition, the selection of partners and alternatives, decision-making criteria, and forms of evaluation. Universities operate not only as producers of knowledge, but also as intermediaries, coordinators, and spaces for experimentation. At the same time, the literature provides limited evidence regarding the processes through which initiatives are maintained, adapted, and eventually incorporated more stably into institutional practices. With regard to the digital dimension, the evidence predominantly points to the coexistence of digital and sustainability agendas or to the instrumental use of digital technologies in support of sustainability objectives, whereas reciprocal relationships and broader forms of institutional integration remain less clearly demonstrated. The main contribution of this review lies in highlighting the limited understanding of the organizational processes that connect the intention to orient innovation toward sustainability with its implementation, evaluation, and continuity.

title: Peran Guru Pendidikan Agama Islam Dalam Pembentukan Karakter Siswa di Era Digital
container-title: IHSAN: Jurnal Penelitian dan Pendidikan Islam
4120d83dc20f9952715b367528999d9d05f2133b.abstract: Perkembangan teknologi digital membawa perubahan terhadap perilaku dan karakter peserta didik, sehingga guru Pendidikan Agama Islam (PAI) memiliki peran penting dalam membentuk karakter yang sesuai dengan nilai-nilai Islam. Artikel ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan peran guru PAI dalam membentuk karakter peserta didik di era digital, mengidentifikasi tantangan yang dihadapi, serta menguraikan strategi yang dapat diterapkan dalam proses pembelajaran. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode studi kepustakaan (library research). Data diperoleh melalui penelaahan artikel jurnal dan referensi akademik yang relevan, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan teknik analisis isi secara deskriptif. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa guru PAI berperan sebagai pendidik, pembimbing, dan teladan dalam menanamkan nilai-nilai keislaman, seperti kejujuran, kedisiplinan, tanggung jawab, dan sikap saling menghormati. Tantangan pembentukan karakter di era digital meliputi ketergantungan terhadap teknologi, perundungan siber, penyebaran informasi yang tidak sesuai dengan nilai moral, serta berkurangnya interaksi sosial secara langsung. Strategi yang dapat diterapkan meliputi keteladanan, pembiasaan perilaku religius, penanaman kedisiplinan, penguatan etika digital, serta kerja sama antara guru dan orang tua. Dengan demikian, pemanfaatan teknologi digital perlu disertai bimbingan dan pengawasan agar dapat mendukung pembentukan karakter peserta didik sesuai dengan nilai-nilai Islam.

title: <b>Contextual Role of Digital Literacy in Impactful Learning and Work Readiness: A Comparative Study of Elementary Teacher Education </b> <b>and Information Technology Students</b>
container-title: Jurnal Inovasi Pendidikan dan Teknologi Informasi (JIPTI)
ce1302e3a1882128848ab71d252aef7e95e2680a.abstract: This study analyzes determinants of impactful learning among Primary School Teacher Education (PGSD) students and of work readiness among Information Technology (IT) students, and compares the role of digital literacy across both contexts. Two separate models were estimated using a quantitative ex post facto design on 222 PGSD students (total sampling) at Universitas Muhammadiyah Muara Bungo and 321 IT students (online survey) at three private universities in Jambi, complemented by interviews with 15 PGSD students. PLS-SEM (SmartPLS 4.1.1.4) and thematic analysis were used. Among PGSD students, instructional design skills (β=0.347; p=0.002) and pedagogical content knowledge (β=0.344; p<0.001) were the main predictors of impactful learning, followed by digital literacy (β=0.205; p=0.018); all were positive and significant (R²=0.700). Interviewees prioritized content knowledge over technology. Among IT students, digital literacy dominated work readiness (direct effect β=0.542; f²=0.576; p<0.001). The indirect effect via work motivation was significant (β=0.197; p<0.001), yielding a total effect of 0.739 (partial mediation). The model explained 86.2% of work readiness variance. Digital literacy is thus the primary determinant in technology-based fields but complementary in pedagogical fields; its role is contextual, not universal. The findings support the Pedagogy Primacy Theory, so curricula should align with each discipline's core competencies. Keywords: Digital Literacy; Impactful Learning; Work Readiness; Work Motivation; Contextuality.

title: <b>From Lexical To Symbolic Capital In English-Indonesian Code Mixing: A Systematic Literature Review On Navigating Digital Identity</b>
container-title: Jurnal Inovasi Pendidikan dan Teknologi Informasi (JIPTI)
05dff1be0a7e82e4b3c9ce806203bf801715ceed.abstract: This study aims to comprehensively map the evolution of the code-mixing phenomenon on digital platforms over the past five years. The method employed is a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) design integrated with Bibliometric Analysis using VOSviewer software. The findings reveal that the use of English-Indonesian code-mixing, or "Indoglish," has significantly shifted from merely filling basic lexical gaps to functioning as a strategic tool for symbolic capital. Users deliberately employ this hybrid language to construct digital personas, project social prestige, and navigate local-global identities within a digital "Third Space". The originality of this research lies in its methodological integration of a PRISMA-guided SLR with bibliometric mapping to objectively trace the paradigm shift in sociolinguistic scholarship. Furthermore, this study explicitly contributes a macro-level framework that redefines digital code-mixing not as linguistic degradation, but as a legitimate, adaptive cultural practice in the network society. Keywords: Code-Mixing; Indoglish; Social Media; Motivation, Digital Identity.

title: <b>Operações de nuvem e DevOps com prioridade à governança para instituições orientadas por missão: um modelo prático para confiabilidade, auditabilidade e inclusão digital</b>
container-title: RCMOS - Revista Científica Multidisciplinar O Saber
0ee8314ea7e00c8a4c9697f277d90c11d42abdea.abstract: Instituições orientadas por missão dependem cada vez mais de práticas de computação em nuvem e DevOps; muitas delas, porém, operam com equipes reduzidas, processos legados e elevadas expectativas de continuidade, prestação de contas e confiança pública. Este artigo propõe um modelo operacional com prioridade à governança para ambientes institucionais de nuvem e DevOps. O modelo organiza as práticas em torno de cinco capacidades que se reforçam mutuamente: linha de base de arquitetura, padronização operacional, segurança e auditabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes, e capacitação da força de trabalho. Em vez de tratar a governança como uma camada documental aplicada após a implementação, o artigo a posiciona como um controle de engenharia que pode ser incorporado a arquiteturas de referência, guias operacionais (runbooks), planos de resposta (playbooks), rotinas de acesso e ciclos de melhoria contínua. O artigo destina-se a líderes e profissionais de TI de organizações do setor público, educacionais, sem fins lucrativos e de orientação comunitária que precisam modernizar a infraestrutura digital sem perder rastreabilidade nem disciplina operacional. O texto sintetiza padrões da prática profissional em arquitetura de nuvem, DevOps, segurança e engenharia de confiabilidade em um modelo aplicável, adaptável a instituições com diferentes níveis de maturidade.

title: <b>LIBERDADE DE IMPRENSA E DIREITO À LIBERDADE NO ORDENAMENTO JURÍDICO BRASILEIRO: PONDERAÇÃO E LIMITES NA ERA DIGITAL</b>
<i>FREEDOM OF THE PRESS AND THE RIGHT TO FREEDOM IN THE BRAZILIAN LEGAL ORDER: BALANCING AND LIMITS IN THE DIGITAL ERA</i>
container-title: Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
4c6ea5c6ab7ac93ecdbde729bbfcfcf81cadf1da.abstract: O presente trabalho analisa a liberdade de imprensa e seus limites diante dos direitos da personalidade no ordenamento jurídico brasileiro, investigando como o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) realiza a ponderação entre as liberdades comunicativas e a proteção da honra, da imagem e da vida privada no contexto das plataformas digitais. A pesquisa é qualitativa, de caráter analítico, baseada em revisão bibliográfica e análise documental de precedentes da Corte, com emprego do método dedutivo. Examinam-se a ADPF 130 e as ADIs 4.451 e 4.815, o Tema 995 da repercussão geral (RE 1.075.412), em seu julgamento de mérito e no aprimoramento da tese por embargos de declaração em 2025, e o julgamento de junho de 2025 que declarou a inconstitucionalidade parcial do artigo 19 do Marco Civil da Internet (Temas 533 e 987). Os resultados indicam que a liberdade de expressão ocupa posição preferencial relativa na arquitetura constitucional, vedada a censura prévia, mas não é absoluta: a responsabilização civil dos veículos por falas de terceiros depende da comprovação de má-fé, caracterizada por dolo ou culpa grave, ao passo que os provedores de aplicação passaram a observar regimes diferenciados conforme a natureza do conteúdo ilícito. Conclui-se que o STF vem refinando seus critérios para equilibrar a livre circulação de informações e a proteção da dignidade humana, embora persistam dispersão jurisprudencial, riscos de assédio judicial contra jornalistas e tensões institucionais, como as suscitadas pelo Inquérito 4.781/DF.

title: P032 | IMPROVEMENT IN DEPRESSIVE AND ANXIETY SYMPTOMS DURING EPTINEZUMAB TREATMENT: A POST-HOC ANALYSIS FROM THE TACHIS STUDY

Migraine outcomes included monthly headache days (MHDs), acute medication days (AMDs), the Migraine Disability Assessment (MIDAS), the Headache Impact Test-6 (HIT-6) and the Migraine-Specific Quality of Life Questionnaire (MSQ). Longitudinal changes were evaluated using mixed-effects models adjusted for demographic and clinical covariates.Results. title: OC11 |  A CASE REPORT OF GALCANEZUMAB-INDUCED MYASTENIA GRAVIS-LIKE SYMPTOMS
container-title: Confinia Cephalalgica
d921fde8052cb63e148e824400284ddb75d70528.abstract: Background. Over the past decade, new migraine treatments, blocking the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) pathway, have been approved and have demonstrated excellent efficacy and an optimal safety profile in both randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and real-world data (1,2). However, pharmacovigilance remains essential, especially for drugs that have been introduced so recently.Methods. We present a clinical case of myasthenia gravis-like symptoms (MyG-l) during treatment with galcanezumab. A 52-year-old woman had suffered from migraine since adolescence, she had no other significant comorbidities; therefore, after failing several prophylactic medications, she began treatment with galcanezumab, achieving an optimal control of her migraine (3). Nevertheless, after 9 months of treatment, she developed right eyelid myoclonus, accompanied by fatigue during prolonged movements of her right hand, increased fatigue while walking, and occasional dysphagia with liquids. Myasthenia gravis was suspected, so several tests were performed. Both anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies and anti-specific muscle kinase antibodies were negative. Laboratory workup, including thyroid function, was normal. A contrast-enhanced chest computed tomography (CT) scan revealed no abnormalities of the thymus. The brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was normal; electroneurography (ENG), electromyography (EMG), repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS), and single-fiber electromyography (SFEMG) were negative. The patient was also prescribed an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor (pyridostigmine), without success. We ultimately decided to discontinue galcanezumab, and the patient reported a subjective improvement in her MyG-l, accompanied by a significant worsening of her migraine. The patient requested to resume treatment with galcanezumab, which led to the recurrence of MyG-l. We therefore decided to permanently discontinue the treatment and to try another preventive therapy.Conclusions. Galcanezumab, fremanezumab, erenumab, and eptinezumab are monoclonal antibodies that target CGRP; gepants, on the other hand, are small molecules that target CGRP. All of these drugs are generally well tolerated, but postmarketing surveillance, as is well known, remains essential for identifying rare adverse events.Our case report is not the only one in the literature that suggests the onset of neuromuscular manifestations following the initiation of therapy with a CGRP antagonist or a CGRP-receptor (CGRPR) antagonist. Another case report of MyG-I following initiation of galcanezumab has been published (4), and there are also two case reports of MyG-I following initiation of erenumab (5,6).In our case, the positive results of both dechallenge and rechallenge are highly indicative of an adverse drug reaction (ADR). According to the Naranjo’s ADR Probability Scale (7), we obtained a score of 8; therefore, this can be considered a probable ADR.Numerous studies have examined the role of CGRP at neuromuscular junctions; most of them have shown that CGRP modulates synaptic transmission by interacting with acetylcholine or its receptor (8), but these findings need to be confirmed, and certainly scientific data are necessary to verify whether anti-CGRP/CGRPR drugs can influence neuromuscular transmission.

title: P025 |  PAIN RELIEF AFTER 30 MINUTES PREDICTS COMPLETE ACUTE TREATMENT SUCCESS AT 12 HOURS: A REAL-WORLD ANALYSIS OF INTRAVENOUS EPTINEZUMAB INFUSION IN HIGHLY REFRACTORY MIGRAINE PATIENTS
container-title: Confinia Cephalalgica
f6520c10c8e3b73bd5d5565c0251bfce59207d84.abstract: Background. Eptinezumab is the intravenous anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody approved for the prevention of episodic and chronic migraine. Data from the RELIEF and the BE-FREE studies demonstrated its rapid onset of action. The BE-FREE is an ongoing Italian observational, prospective, multicenter, real-world study exploring the very early changes in migraine pain intensity and associated symptoms from 30 minutes (T30) to 48 hours after eptinezumab infusion, when an acute migraine attack is ongoing.In this analysis of the BE-FREE study we evaluated whether a very early pain intensity reduction predicts the 12 hours (T12) treatment success.Methods. We evaluated 22 patients undergoing eptinezumab infusion (100 mg or 300 mg) during an acute migraine attack. Baseline (T0) data included socio-demographic and clinical variables as diagnosis, monthly migraine days (MMDs), presence of Medication Overuse Headache (MOH), headache pain intensity (Numeric Rating Scale, NRS) and previous failed preventives. We also analyzed the time interval between the onset of the migraine attack and the infusion. Painkillers were prohibited in the previous 24 hours.For this analysis we focused on the variation of NRS score at T30, accordingly patients were classified as: i) Rapid Responders (RRs) defined as those with a >50% NRS reduction at T30, ii) Delayed Responders/Non-Responders (DRs) those without. The NRS variation from T0 to T12 in the 2 groups was also evaluated. Statistical comparisons of NRS score at T12 was performed using the non-parametric Mann-Whitney U test.Results. The cohort (n=22, 86.4%F, median age of 43.3, SD15 years) presented a highly refractory clinical profile, with a baseline MMDs of 20.0 (IQR: 15-30), a mean of 4.8 prior preventive treatment failures, a high prevalence of chronic migraine (72.7%) and 59% of MOH. Data were collected at different eptinezumab infusions, mainly at I infusion (15 patients, 68.2%); the attack had started 3.9 ± 2 h before the infusion. Eptinezumab was administered at a dose of 100 mg in 17 patients (77.3%) and of 300 mg in 5 patients (22.7%). At 30 minutes, 7 patients (31.8%) achieved a > 50% pain reduction and were classified as RRs. Strikingly, at 12 hours, 100% of RRs (7/7) achieved a complete pain-free status (NRS = 0). In contrast, the DR group (N=15) exhibited a slower, heterogeneous recovery, with a mean NRS of 3.7 at 12 hours. The RRs experienced a significantly lower pain intensity from T0 to T12 (p = 0.0244) and a significantly greater absolute pain reduction at 12 hours (p = 0.0417), with an average decrease of 5.86 points vs 2.57 points in DRs. Eptinezumab dosage (100 mg vs 300 mg) did not correlate with the very early response at 30 minutes.Conclusions. These findings suggest that in highly refractory migraine patients undergoing eptinezumab treatment during a migraine attack, a NRS score reduction of >50% within 30 minutes of infusion is not merely an indicator of immediate relief but may be a prognostic marker predicting a complete pain-free status at 12 hours.Luisa Fofi, Claudia Altamura on behalf of the Italian Headache Registry (RICe) Study Group.

title: Impact of a hospital digital coordination centre on patient flow in a large tertiary centre
160334232a075910c280219fb20b70a01409ded6.abstract: Abstract Hospitals globally are under increasing strain due to rising demand and constrained capacity. This interrupted-time-series study evaluates the impact of a digital coordination centre, implemented on 28 August 2023, where a multidisciplinary operational team (comprising data scientists, patient flow managers, facilities managers, patient transport and nursing staff, for example) use real-time data dashboards showing measures of emergency department (ED) crowding and inpatient utilisation to optimise patient flow in an Australian metropolitan tertiary hospital. Analysis of 195,385 emergency department arrivals admitted to acute care and 184,454 acute inpatient episodes between July 2020 and June 2025 showed substantial improvements in measures of patient flow: 33% decrease in ED length of stay, 73% increase in hospital admissions from the ED within four hours of arrival, 8% decrease in inpatient length of stay, and 5% increase in discharges completed before noon. These changes coincided with a broader programme of organisational and operational reform, of which the DCC was a central integrating component. Hence, the findings support digitally enabled coordination centres as an effective contribution to the overall strategy for improving hospital operational efficiency.

title: أثر التداخل بين الذاكرة العاملة والانتباه التنفيذي في اكتساب المفاهيم المجردة لدى طلاب المرحلة الثانوية
The Effect of the Interaction between Working Memory and Executive Attention on the Acquisition of Abstract Concepts among Secondary School Students
container-title: Journal Of Babylon Center for Humanities Studies
49b25447bf2bd95d7691b99310b3f9b63c712632.abstract: يتناول هذا البحث أثر التداخل الوظيفي بين الذاكرة العاملة والانتباه التنفيذي في تفسير اكتساب المفاهيم المجردة لدى طلاب المرحلة الثانوية، في إطار منظور معرفي تكاملي ينظر إلى التعلم بوصفه عملية ديناميكية ناتجة عن تفاعل أنظمة معرفية متعددة. وتبرز أهمية الموضوع في كونه يعالج أحد التحديات المركزية في التعلم المجرد، خاصة في المجالات التي تتطلب معالجة رمزية معقدة، مثل الرياضيات والمنطق، حيث لا يكفي تفسير الأداء المعرفي عبر متغيرات منفصلة، بل من خلال مستوى تكاملها الوظيفي. اعتمد البحث المنهج الوصفي التحليلي ذي الطابع الارتباطي التفسيري، باستخدام تحليل الانحدار المتعدد لاختبار العلاقات المباشرة والتفاعلية بين المتغيرات. وقد جُمعت البيانات من عينة من طلاب المرحلة الثانوية باستخدام أدوات مقننة شملت اختبارات الذاكرة العاملة (اللفظية والبصرية)، ومهام الانتباه التنفيذي مثل اختبار ستروب، إضافة إلى اختبار تحصيلي لقياس مستوى اكتساب المفاهيم المجردة، مع ضبط متغيرات مثل العمر والتحصيل الدراسي. أظهرت النتائج وجود علاقة ارتباطية دالة إحصائيًا بين الذاكرة العاملة والانتباه التنفيذي، كما تبين أن كليهما يسهم في التنبؤ بالأداء المعرفي، غير أن التأثير التفاعلي بينهما كان الأكثر قوة في تفسير اكتساب المفاهيم المجردة، مما يشير إلى أن كفاءة التعلم تعتمد على درجة التكامل بين عمليات التخزين والتنظيم المعرفي. كما كشفت النتائج عن دور وسيط للانتباه التنفيذي في تعزيز فاعلية الذاكرة العاملة أثناء معالجة المعلومات المجردة. وتدعم هذه النتائج بناء نموذج تفسيري يوجّه نحو تطوير استراتيجيات تعليمية قائمة على تنمية الوظائف التنفيذية بصورة تكاملية، مع إعادة النظر في تصميم المناهج بما ينسجم مع الطبيعة البنيوية للتعلم المعرفي.
