title: Navigating AI-Assisted Lesson Planning: A Qualitative Inquiry into Teachers’ Challenges and Adaptive Strategies in Using ILAW
container-title: Asian Journal of Education and Social Studies
304712da99aa0dce2dd4354f1ced28f67e3ab5e6.abstract: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in education has provided teachers with additional ways to prepare instructional materials and develop lesson plans. However, using AI in lesson planning also presents challenges, particularly in schools with limited access to technology and internet services. This study explored the lived experiences of public elementary school teachers in using AI-assisted ILAW lesson planning, focusing on the challenges they encountered, the ways they addressed these difficulties, and the support they needed to improve their use of AI. A qualitative phenomenological research design was employed to understand the experiences and perspectives of the participants. The study involved six public elementary school teachers at Catub Elementary School, located in Paddaoan, Conner, Apayao. Data were gathered through a semi-structured interview guide, which allowed the participants to share their experiences, difficulties, and suggestions regarding the use of AI in preparing ILAW lesson plans. The responses were examined and organised according to common experiences and ideas shared by the participants. The results showed that teachers considered AI a useful tool for generating lesson ideas, suggesting classroom activities, providing examples, and organising lesson content. However, they experienced difficulties related to poor internet connectivity, power interruptions, limited ICT equipment, difficulty downloading learning resources, and the need to check and revise AI-generated content. To address these concerns, teachers used alternative ways to access AI, practised writing clearer prompts, verified information using curriculum guides and other learning materials, and adjusted suggested activities to suit their pupils' abilities and available resources. The participants also expressed the need for practical AI training, reliable internet access, adequate ICT equipment, and continuous technical support. The study concludes that AI can assist teachers in lesson preparation, but its effective use still depends on teachers' knowledge, professional judgement, and understanding of their learners. It is therefore recommended that schools provide relevant training, improve access to ICT resources, and encourage teachers to share experiences and good practices in using AI responsibly.

title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) In Distance Education at Sokoto State Tertiary Institution: A Pathway to Enhanced Learning
container-title: WORLD JOURNAL OF INNOVATION AND MODERN TECHNOLOGY
22c375a2529c8a5386cacb31f0df8f65715944e6.abstract: This research study explores the potential benefits and challenges of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) distance education in Sokoto state tertiary institutions. The rapid advancement of AI technologies presents an opportunity to revolutionize the delivery of education, particularly in the context of distance learning. This research aims to investigate the impact of AI on personalize learning experiences, administrative efficiency and students support services in the context of Sokoto state tertiary institutions. The study employed a mixed-method approach, incorporating both quantitative and qualitative data collection methods. Survey and interviews were conducted with students, educators and administrators to gather insight into their perceptions and the experiences with AI-enabled distance education. Additionally, data analysis will be conducted to assess the effectiveness of AI tools in improving learning outcomes, automating administrative tasks and enhancing and support. The finding of this research will contribute to the existing body of knowledge on the integration of AI in distance education, with a specific focus on the unique needs and challenges faced by Sokoto state tertiary institutions. The research outcome will provide valuable insight for educational policy makers, administrators and educators seeking to leverage AI technologies to enhance the quality and accessibility of distance education in Sokoto state.

title: Generative AI Adoption in Educational Administration: An Extended UTAUT Model with Trust, Privacy Concern, and Institutional Policy Fit
container-title: Higher Education Studies
f7072b5c40077f1df1ac89c56a011e1250ca1e5c.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly promoted as a tool for educational administration and administrative decision-making, yet evidence on why educational leaders adopt it remains scarce, particularly in technical and vocational education. Extending the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology (UTAUT) with trust, privacy concern, and institutional policy fit, this study examined the determinants of administrators&rsquo; GenAI behavioral intention and use behavior. The study analyzed survey responses from 330 directors and deputy directors of Thai private vocational colleges, selected through two-stage stratified cluster sampling. The data were analyzed using generalized structured component analysis (GSCA) and bootstrapping. The measurement model showed satisfactory reliability and validity. The model fitted the data well and explained 82.9% of the variance in behavioral intention and 79.3% in use behavior. Social influence, trust, lower privacy concern, and institutional policy fit significantly predicted behavioral intention, whereas the unique direct effects of performance expectancy, effort expectancy, and facilitating conditions could not be separated from those of the correlated predictors; dominance analysis showed that these three determinants accounted for about one third of the explained variance in intention, almost all of it shared with the other predictors. Effort expectancy and facilitating conditions also shaped social influence, through which their influence reached intention. Behavioral intention, trust, and lower privacy concern predicted use behavior. Full-collinearity diagnostics indicated a risk of common method variance; a post hoc marker-variable analysis showed that the predictors of intention and the intention-use path were robust, whereas the direct effects of trust and privacy concern on use were not. Administrators&rsquo; adoption of GenAI thus appears to depend on institutional legitimacy, normative endorsement, and data-governance assurance, which explain intention beyond what instrumental appraisal explains. Educational authorities seeking to promote GenAI in administration should therefore pair infrastructure investment with explicit institutional GenAI policies, guidelines for verifying GenAI outputs, and data-protection safeguards, because these conditions add to, rather than merely duplicate, beliefs about usefulness.

title: Evaluating Public Plans for AI Systems: Comparing Premortem and Promortems
container-title: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
93786624d5e2943550a5e72efa2ed4ce300ad708.abstract: Effective planning requires anticipating risks before they occur, yet planners often underestimate potential failures due to optimism bias. This research compared three reasoning techniques—critique, premortem, and promortem—for evaluating a proposed automated high-speed rail plan across two experiments (individual, N = 108; group, N = 30). Participants rated their confidence and understanding of the plan before and after generating reasons, then generated potential solutions. Premortem reasoning reduced participants’ confidence in the plan and then supported confidence recovery once solutions were generated, whereas promortem reasoning increased confidence throughout the session, consistent with optimism bias; effects were more pronounced in group settings. Critique and premortem elicited a higher proportion of reasons and solutions related to the plan’s AI than promortem. Findings support the premortem as a tool for calibrating confidence and generating actionable, domain-relevant risks during early-stage technology planning.

title: Lexico-syntactic complexity in human and AI-generated outputs across interpreting and translation: a paired-corpus study
container-title: Journal of China Computer-Assisted Language Learning
8b9e2ae1eabe93ee80d3bcdf914c847b46a6d5c2.abstract: Abstract This study examines differences in lexico-syntactic complexity between human translation outputs and AI-generated texts under interpreting and translation conditions, with implications for computer-assisted language learning (CALL) and translator/interpreter education. The dataset comprises 60 source segments and their corresponding human and AI outputs, yielding 120 texts. Human and AI texts were source-paired within each mode, while cross-mode comparisons were conducted using quasi-comparable corpora. Five lexical and eight syntactic complexity measures were analyzed to examine mode-related and agent-related differences. The results show dimension-specific mode dependence: AI-human differences in lexical complexity varied significantly across modes, whereas syntactic differences did not. Under the interpreting condition, AI-generated texts showed higher values on all five lexical measures, whereas human interpreting showed higher values on five syntactic measures. Under the translation condition, AI-human differences were reduced and confined to lexical density and sophistication, with no statistically significant differences on the eight syntactic measures. These findings suggest that AI-generated texts tend to display greater lexical concentration and written-like features, while human interpreting reflects characteristics of online language production and structural extension. Source-paired human and AI texts can serve as comparative resources for CALL and translator/interpreter training, helping learners critically evaluate AI outputs through linguistic features, textual evidence, and production conditions. Overall, AI-human complexity differences are not fixed properties of translation agents but vary according to complexity dimensions and production contexts.

title: Where Does Accountability Lie in Deployed AI Systems? Using Cognitive Work Analysis to Address the Value-Alignment Problem
container-title: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
867ba8d15e1c2634aed9980b69c3fc66502bd4d7.abstract: Increased use of Artificial Intelligence raises questions around mitigating unintended consequences. Technical perspectives on these questions lead to calls for “Responsible AI,” while regulatory perspectives lead to calls for increased human oversight. Neither perspective fully addresses the core issues surrounding accountability in the sociotechnical systems in which AI operates. Human oversight is a form of supervisory control, in which the role of the human is to monitor AI performance within defined constraints, and this requires consideration of who defines the constraints, where accountability lies when the constraints are exceeded, and how AI performance can be interpreted by human supervisors. For us, constraints correspond to system’s Values and a challenge lies in aligning system operations with these Values. We demonstrate the use of Work Domain Analysis to map purpose-related functions (i.e., activity performed in a sociotechnical system) to Values (weighted according to the functional purpose of the organization).

title: Exploring Ethical Controversies in AI-Generated Art Based on Fundamental Principles
container-title: Computing&AI Connect
56590a5c7ada2eff17368f2e8a23c7a9751048d8.abstract: This paper will discuss from a technical standpoint the issues that lie at the heart of controversies over AI-generated art. Rather than ethical and legal debates, it proposes that intuitive public criticism has grasped well the way the generative model fundamentally works. Drawing on an analysis of principles guiding diffusion models and large-scale artificial datasets upon which they actually depend (despite popular beliefs), this study suggests that AI Art is in fact a surface-level statistical recombination process—that there is no actual intentionality, conceptual reasoning, or life expe-rience behind it as there is with human artistic creation. What happens mechanistically is that this technology learns very complex patterns and correlations existing within training data; its output thus becomes an odds mixture from such data rather than any original concept. It further proves that concrete technical evidence points to its inherent derivativeness-from unique model "fingerprints," stylistic homogenization, and detectable statistical artifacts to the fact that it still requires so much prompting from humans. Thus, these are not loopholes of limitations but rather built-in features of the present paradigm of data-driven pattern matching. A principle- and technically-grounded understanding of how this technology actually functions would be urgently needed for responsible consideration of its social, cultural, and economic impacts—not its output. This analysis finally validates the core concerns of the art world as a correct intuitive interpretation of the reality of artificial intelligence operation and not an emotional reaction. In the reality of AI operation, creation is reconstructed as a complex form of replication.

title: From Function to System: Artificial Intelligence and the Propagation of Economic Change
container-title: AI for Society
e81375257080aa996dd09421c2b96a89f3acb241.abstract: Artificial intelligence expands the set of functions technically delegable to artificial systems, but technical possibility determines neither the timing nor the form of adoption. This Concept Paper develops a mechanism-specific account linking three analytical levels that are usually examined separately: the technically delegable function, the organization that reallocates its execution, and the economic system through which resulting dependencies may converge and propagate. The analytical strategy is to specify the transitions connecting these levels, define their boundary conditions, derive explicit propositions from the inferential chain, and use historical and contemporary evidence only to document individual links rather than to test the mechanism as a whole. Dependency restructuring is defined as a reallocation-induced change in the directed configuration of contributions required to obtain a functional result. Its economic significance depends on such attributes as criticality, location and control, duration, substitutability, switching costs, and dependency reach. The framework distinguishes an anticipatory channel in which credible expectations alter commitments before adoption, from an operational channel based on effective functional reallocation. Systemic propagation is distinguished from diffusion and simple aggregation: it becomes possible when heterogeneous reallocations converge on common nodes whose properties allow for changes in capacity, price, availability, or access to be transmitted across organizational configurations. Three propositions specify observable contrasts concerning anticipatory commitments, organizational exposure and cross-organizational transmission. Similar adoption rates may therefore generate different systemic consequences when the underlying dependency architectures differ. The account is conditional and recursive rather than technologically deterministic.

title: In Situ Characterization of Local Thermal–Hydraulic Characteristics in a Liquid-Cooling Cold Plate for AI Servers Using an Embedded Flexible MEMS Microsensor
container-title: Micromachines
8051ab7fd04efe9480be8674b8a65779ff2f8d3f.abstract: A flexible MEMS microsensor integrating temperature, thermal-flow, and capacitive-pressure sensing was developed for embedded monitoring in liquid-cooling systems. The sensing elements were fabricated on a 50-μm polyimide substrate and protected by a patterned PI 9320 layer. Two microsensors were installed near the inlet and outlet of a commercial cold plate and evaluated at nominal coolant flow rates of 2–4 L/min. The measured local temperature difference decreased from approximately 4.8 to 3.2 °C as the nominal flow rate increased, with a temperature difference of approximately 4.4 °C at 3 L/min. Temperature-dependent calibration curves were established for the flow and pressure channels. In a separate 120 h circulation test using a dedicated flow channel, all three sensing channels remained operational. The temperature, flow, and pressure sensitivities decreased by 7.2%, 5.4%, and 4.7%, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating flexible multiparameter microsensors into existing liquid-cooling hardware and provide an experimental basis for embedded cooling-system monitoring.

title: Operational Use and AI Governance of LLM-Assisted Split Procurement Detection in University Internal Auditing
container-title: Systems
247fbb027939590188cb63d0bdb8d2cb0ff3ecb7.abstract: This study examines how large language model (LLM) assessments were used in an actual university internal audit. We analyzed system outputs, audit records, and accounts from two meetings with audit staff. A cloud implementation of a previously developed method processed 1,860,622 voucher line items covering 12 months. Candidate analysis covered eight organizational units. Across three monetary thresholds, 949 threshold-specific candidates were assigned to the three higher review-priority categories. After audit-specific filtering, auditors reviewed approximately 700 candidates, exported 36 for detailed examination, and selected four for departmental inquiry. They compared their own assessments with LLM-generated rationales and retained some uncertain candidates for further investigation. They also used priorities to decide how thoroughly to review candidates, depending on the volume in each department. Thus, LLM output informed both the interpretation of transactions and the allocation of review effort. These findings extend research on human oversight by showing how scrutiny of LLM rationales can coexist with reliance on priorities when allocating review effort. Independent evaluation of detection performance and time savings remains necessary.

title: AI-ENABLED REMOTE SENSING FOR SMART CITIES COVERING FROM HYPERLOCAL TO THE HYPERSKY
container-title: Street Art & Urban Creativity
1d233b902a9ec4c28aa49415f6fe58e117999c33.abstract: Smart cities need observations that connect regional change with local intervention. Remote sensing can combine satellite coverage, drone detail and hyperlocal sensors (Internet of Things) to improve urban planning. This evidence-based synthesis examines parking, urban heat, wildfire and air-quality applications, separating validated results from commercial specifications and scenarios. European thermal missions and very low Earth orbit (VLEO) initiatives expand opportunities for urban planning. A decision-oriented architecture links these capabilities to governed, quality-qualified services without presenting simulations or provider specifications as field validation. We propose decision-specific validation and adaptive acquisition, identifying VLEO opportunities while distinguishing emerging capabilities from operational services. Value depends on usable coverage, uncertainty and timely urban action.

title: ANALYSIS OF THE ROLE OF DIGITAL MARKETING AND SERVICE QUALITY ON PURCHASING DECISIONS FOR CAT TREE PRODUCTS FROM CASPIRA MSMES
container-title: Referensi : Jurnal Ilmu Manajemen dan Akuntansi
4a62f017bbae966916a9722153e8d941ead90502.abstract: Purpose: This study investigates the role of digital marketing and service quality on purchasing decisions. This study uses a quantitative methodology. Methods: This study uses primary data collected through an online survey with a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5 points. The study population includes all consumers of Caspira MSMEs in Semarang Regency. The sampling technique uses non-random sampling with a purposive sampling method. The total number of participants is 40 respondents who have purchased Caspira MSME products. Data analysis: The data analysis technique uses multiple linear regression, and the data is processed with the SmartPLS 4.1.1.4 program. Result and discussions: This study illustrates that the role of digital marketing and service quality significantly and positively influences purchasing decisions. Conclusion: This study provides benefits for consumers as a basis for decision-making related to purchasing decisions at Caspira MSMEs, which are formed by many exogenous variables that influence endogenous variables.

title: Information barriers in digital administrative interfaces: a process-oriented framework for administrative burden
container-title: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
f13c881e32b41e48d0cd00477ccb110d842b5720.abstract: Abstract Research on administrative burden has demonstrated that policy design shapes individuals’ ability to access rights and public services. However, the role of information in producing and transforming administrative burden remains insufficiently conceptualized. This article proposes a process-oriented framework that positions information barriers as a key mechanism through which administrative burden emerges. The framework conceptualizes administrative encounters as an informational trajectory composed of four stages: information search, comprehension, application, and continuous learning, and demonstrates how barriers at each stage generate distinct combinations of learning, compliance, and psychological costs. It further develops a structured framework that links types of information barriers to concrete, evidence-based intervention strategies drawn from information science, including plain language, content structuring, interface design, and mediation mechanisms. By highlighting the dynamic role of information in increasingly digital governance, the article shows how digital service provision can both reduce and intensify administrative burden by reshaping access to information and redistributing responsibilities between citizens and bureaucratic institutions.

title: Legal Regulation of the Use of Information and Digital Technologies in the Exercise and Guaranteeing of Reproductive Rights and Reproductive Health
container-title: State power and local self-government
3f597d1324af177aeda96b2d6d01e76a0b263feb.abstract: As part of the work, a comprehensive analysis was conducted of the legal regulation of the use of information and digital technologies in the field of implementing and guaranteeing reproductive rights and reproductive health. The introduction of digital technologies in the field of reproductive health affects not only the rights and dignity of an individual but can also have a comprehensive impact and change social roles of parents and social relations. Options for using digital technologies in the field of reproductive health, as well as the legal and ethical problems associated with such use, were examined in order to develop a comprehensive and systematic approach to legal regulation, taking into account bioethics and bioconstitutionalism.

title: Suspension of Disposal of Digital Currency in Criminal Proceedings: The Procedural Mechanism and Judicial Practice
container-title: RUSSIAN INVESTIGATOR
ee5c118c32543a5254fe9400976454be502ffaf7.abstract: The article, drawing on Russian judicial practice and the doctrine of criminal procedure, examines the suspension of disposal of digital currency as a form of seizure of property. The analysis highlights the specific features of digital currency as an object of seizure and confiscation and explores the relationship between Articles 111 and 115 of the Criminal Procedure Code of the Russian Federation and special legislation on digital assets with law-enforcement decisions in cases involving illicit drug trafficking and the laundering of criminal proceeds. The article further examines the significance of Federal Law No. 38-FZ of February 20, 2026, which recognized digital currency as property for the purposes of criminal law and established special rules for its seizure (Parts 7.1–7.2 of Article 115 of the Criminal Procedure Code of the Russian Federation) and the procedure for its seizure during investigative actions (Article 164.2 of the Criminal Procedure Code of the Russian Federation). The paper describes models of digital currency flows in criminal cases, the procedural steps taken by investigators and courts when preparing and considering motions for seizure, as well as the set of technical actions and practical guidelines for cooperation between investigative authorities, courts, Rosfinmonitoring, credit institutions and operators of exchange services.

title: A Digital Currency as a Means of Money Laundering: A Criminal Law Analysis of the Issue in the Russian Federation
container-title: RUSSIAN INVESTIGATOR
27d709f321430bddbf33aa9fd0659f2a07af906f.abstract: This article presents a criminal-legal analysis of the use of digital currency as a means of legalization (money laundering) of criminal proceeds in the Russian Federation. The concept of digital currency under Federal Law No. 259-FZ, its legal status, and qualification problems of crimes under Articles 174 and 174.1 of the Criminal Code in the absence until 2026 of direct recognition of digital currency as property in the Criminal Code are examined. The approaches of judicial practice and the clarifications of the Resolution of the Plenum of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation No. 32 are analyzed, while attention is given to the position of the legislator as expressed in Legislative Draft No. 902782-8 on recognizing digital currency as an object of property rights for the purposes of criminal and criminal-procedural law. Based on the conducted research, conclusions and proposals are formulated aimed at enhancing the effectiveness of counteraction to the legalization of criminal proceeds using digital currencies.

title: Transformation of the Legal Mechanism for Managing Digital Risks in the Context of Countering External Economic Threats
container-title: The Legal World
01bef28054501a5dbdfaab9471815431989d878b.abstract: The restructuring of economic relations, driven by the transformation of data into a key production resource, requires a revision of established approaches to risk management. The article examines managerial and legal relations arising in the course of transforming digital risk management mechanisms under the influence of external economic threats. The methodological basis of the study comprises formal legal analysis, systems analysis, the comparative legal method, and legal modeling. As a result of the study, a conceptual model has been developed for integrating the risk management system into data processing processes; key determinants of the transformation have been identified, including a paradigm shift regarding the object of risk, the external economic determinant, and the juridification of technological procedures. The author substantiates the conclusion that the effectiveness of countering external economic threats in the digital sphere depends on a transition from fragmented regulation to the creation of a holistic digital risk management ecosystem embedded in the management decision-making loop.

title: Digitalisation and Digital Transformation in Tax Administrations
Pendampingan Penerjemahan Tulis Kitab Kuning Berbasis Gamifikasi Digital dan Koreksi Mandiri bagi Mahasiswa

695cea85ada5428e1d505075c295f9b261bbea9e.abstract: Keterbatasan presisi sintaksis dan tingginya kejenuhan belajar dalam mentranslasi teks klasik masih menjadi hambatan utama bagi pembelajaran bahasa Arab pemula. Kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan mengoptimalkan kecakapan terjemah tulis kitab turats secara presisi melalui skema pendampingan berbasis gamifikasi digital dan fitur koreksi terotomatisasi guna menekan angka kesalahan gramatikal serta memantik motivasi intrinsik mahasiswa semester II Pendidikan Bahasa Arab Universitas Nurul Jadid. Metode pelaksanaan mengadopsi pendekatan Asset-Based Community Development (ABCD) yang dioperasionalkan secara sistematis melalui empat tahapan utama, yakni sosialisasi diagnostik, pelatihan alih teknologi, mentoring klinis interaktif, dan evaluasi dampak program. Solusi terpadu yang diterapkan meliputi pemanfaatan asisten virtual Machine Translation berorientasi self-correction AI, penyusunan bagan skematis visual multimodal untuk mendekonstruksi struktur kalimat kompleks, serta rekayasa atmosfer kelas melalui misi permainan berjenjang (quest-based learning). Hasil pengabdian mengonfirmasi peningkatan performa akademik mahasiswa secara signifikan, di mana rerata nilai kognitif merangkak naik dari angka 58 pada pratindakan menjadi 76 pada evaluasi pertengahan, selaras dengan penurunan tingkat kesalahan sintaksis dan morfologis sebesar 63%. Intervensi ini berhasil menghasilkan luaran konkrit berupa penerbitan buku saku panduan teknis, publikasi artikel ilmiah pengabdian, dan sertifikat Hak Kekayaan Intelektual. Simpulan kegiatan membuktikan bahwa integrasi antara teknologi translasi terotomatisasi dan dinamika gamifikasi digital efektif meningkatkan akurasi tata bahasa serta keterlibatan emosional mahasiswa dalam proses pembelajaran. Sebagai rekomendasi, skema pendampingan hibrida ini sangat prospektif untuk diadopsi sebagai model prototipe dalam kurikulum pembelajaran kitab turats berkelanjutan di lingkungan perguruan tinggi keagamaan Islam.

title: Implications of Digital Resources on English Language Pedagogy in Jigawa State Senior Secondary Schools
container-title: JALINGO JOURNAL OF LINGUISTICS AND LITERARY STUDIES
ba804c9984b3cf65b1b475f13493c596ba063ab7.abstract: The importance of digital resources in teaching and learning language has been widely recognized as a catalyst for fostering improved language proficiency. Despite the advantages, most schools in Nigeria grapple with different impediments for proper digital integration. This paper assesses the availability of the digital resources in teaching and learning English in Jigawa State Senior Secondary Schools. The two inter-related objectives are to find out the availability of both hardware and software resources in the selected schools and the types of the digital resources being used in the selected schools in the teaching and learning of the English language. The study adopts descriptive design using purposive sampling the total of sixty students (distributed as 10 per school) are selected from the six sampled schools. The schools are also purposively selected two per each senatorial district to represent the three senatorial districts that made up the Jigawa State. As for the teachers, two teachers of English language are selected in each of the schools. This makes the total number of teacher-respondents as twelve (12). Questionnaires are designed in two forms. One form of the questionnaires is administered to teachers, while the second form is administered to the students. The analysis is done using percentage and frequency. The findings indicated that while there has been an average distribution and provision of digital resources for teaching and learning purposes, there has not been specific provision of such resources for the purpose of teaching and learning English. Also, the results indicated that most of the resources available are in hardware forms, while the software resources are not adequately provided. It recommended that policies and decisions by the governments and other stakeholders should be tailored to consider the provision of language learning resources and also the provision of digital resources should focus more on software resources.

title: Influence of Translanguaging on Pragmatic Meaning and Intercultural Identity among Nigerian University Learners of French in Digital Communication.
container-title: JALINGO JOURNAL OF LINGUISTICS AND LITERARY STUDIES
f5a80511499ee4484e8fc62b3051f752702f25b9.abstract: The expansion of digital communication has created new spaces for Nigerian learners of French to interact, exchange ideas and express themselves across linguistic and cultural boundaries. This study examines translanguaging among Nigerian university learners of French as a foreign language in digital communication, with particular attention to pragmatic meaning and intercultural identity. It explores how learners draw on French, English, Nigerian Pidgin and indigenous Nigerian languages to express intentions, sustain relationships, interpret culturally embedded expressions and negotiate aspects of their identities during online interactions. The study adopts a qualitative research design based on naturally occurring digital exchanges and learner-generated online texts, complemented by relevant participant accounts. Data are analysed through qualitative discourse and thematic analysis, drawing on translanguaging, pragmatic and intercultural perspectives, with attention to clarification, politeness, humour, emotional expression, solidarity, cultural references and identity positioning. Findings indicate that learners’ flexible use of their linguistic resources is not merely a response to limitations in French proficiency. Rather, translanguaging enables them to convey contextually appropriate meanings, express cultural experiences, establish rapport and negotiate their social and intercultural identities. The study concludes that digital communication provides a dynamic space for multilingual interaction and that recognising learners’ complete linguistic repertoires can support pragmatic development, meaningful French language learning and intercultural understanding.

title: Influence of Digital Fact-Checking on Residents’ Perception of Development News in Uyo Local Government Area, Akwa Ibom State
container-title: JALINGO JOURNAL OF LINGUISTICS AND LITERARY STUDIES
3aa8c679d2f5fc145fe0ee35ac1ce3b5731916dc.abstract: This study investigates the influence of digital fact-checking on the perception of development news among residents of Uyo Local Government Area, Akwa Ibom State. The study investigates among other objectives, the awareness level of Uyo residents about digital fact checking and the extent to which digital fact checking has influenced the perception of Uyo residents on development news. Utilising a survey research design, the research targeted a projected population of 450,000 residents in Uyo based on 2006 census projected figures. Employing Philip Meyer’s formula for large population, a sample size of 384 respondents is derived to ensure statistical validity. To enhance the robustness of the findings, a multi-step, cluster and convenience sampling technique is adopted. This is achieved through the clustering of Uyo Local Government into eleven clusters representing eleven Wards that make up the Local Government Area. The study also adopts some theoretical underpinning to include the social responsibility theory, the technological determinism theory, the two step flow media theory and the multistep flow theories. Findings from the study indicate among others that, Uyo residents are aware of digital fact checking process but were not aware of the platforms and components of fact checking. The study therefore concludes that the Residents of Uyo are fully aware of the practice of digital fact checking but not aware of the various platforms this could be achieved therefore has not benefited optimally from the practice. It recommends therefore that advocacy agencies and groups should initiate broader strategies and discourse on media literacy and responsible information consumption in the digital age.

title: Bearing fault diagnosis of rolling machinery based on spatial pyramid channel attention network with depthwise separable convolution
container-title: Engineering Computations
ac8de549d0c263d536d5003d12d7eeb6f37d0532.abstract: Purpose Rolling bearings are critical components in rotating machinery, and their fault diagnosis is essential for ensuring safe equipment operation. However, traditional fault diagnosis methods face challenges including insufficient feature extraction, high computational complexity and difficulties in multi-scale information fusion. To address these issues, this paper proposes a spatial pyramid channel attention network with depthwise separable convolution for intelligent fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. Design/methodology/approach Continuous wavelet transform converts 1D vibration signals into 2D time-frequency images. An efficient feature extraction block integrates depthwise separable convolution, multi-scale dilated convolution and a cross-spatial multi-scale attention module to expand the receptive field while reducing complexity. A cross-spatial multi-scale attention mechanism uses parallel 1D global average pooling paths to capture long-range dependencies. Finally, a channel-spatial synergy module combines spatial pyramid structure and channel information interaction to establish inter-channel dependencies while preserving multi-scale spatial information. Findings Experimental results on three public datasets from Jiangnan University (JNU), Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU-SY) and Paderborn University (PU) demonstrate that the proposed method achieves diagnostic accuracies of 99.94%, 98.94% and 98.55%, respectively, showing superior diagnostic precision and better generalization capability compared to existing methods. Ablation experiments further validate the effectiveness of each core module. Originality/value This paper proposes a novel spatial pyramid channel attention network with depthwise separable convolution that synergistically integrates multi-scale dilated convolution, cross-spatial attention and channel-spatial synergy. The method effectively addresses challenges of insufficient feature extraction, high computational complexity and multi-scale fusion difficulties in rolling bearing fault diagnosis, demonstrating superior diagnostic accuracy and generalization capability across multiple public datasets.

title: AI governance as co-regulation: a practitioner-informed framework for defense-sector small and medium-sized enterprises
container-title: Digital Policy, Regulation and Governance
567df46acd778f8be8494c9ae84f8e44b8ec75da.abstract: Purpose This paper aims to examine how practitioners supporting defense-sector small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) place artificial intelligence (AI) governance within the coregulatory regime of National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-171, the cybersecurity maturity model certification program, contracts and assessors. Design/methodology/approach An exploratory survey of 38 practitioners, recruited through a public LinkedIn post, combined a risk-to-control-family mapping task, artifact feasibility ratings and open-ended responses. Analysis was descriptive, with exploratory correlations adjusted for multiplicity and one researcher coded the open text. Findings Respondents concentrated AI risk on a few evidence-bearing control families, led by audit and accountability, risk assessment, access control and system and information integrity. Perceived compliance strain was high and readiness low. Artifacts resembling existing evidence, such as audit trail exports, were rated most feasible. Guidance ambiguity was the leading barrier. No exploratory association survived adjustment for multiplicity. Research limitations/implications The purposive sample and self-reported perceptions support pattern identification, not population estimates or claims about implementation outcomes. Practical implications Assessors and prime contractors could reduce SME burden by publishing exemplar AI evidence artifacts mapped to existing control families. Originality/value The study develops coregulation as a lens on the evidence burden of small firms at the base of regulatory chains, reports the full risk-to-control matrix and derives a seven-module framework that separates survey-supported elements from design choices.

title: Decoding cyber fraud governance in banking: a lifecycle misalignment perspective on prevention, detection and mitigation
container-title: Digital Policy, Regulation and Governance
d1e7a00f53f0ba2019bcde2f244daa7e55a35933.abstract: Purpose The rapid digital transformation of banking and financial services has made cyber fraud a significant governance challenge. Against this backdrop, earlier studies have examined cyber fraud governance from technological, behavioural, organisational and regulatory aspects, but existing information remains uneven. This study aims to systematically synthesize the literature, assess the impact of this fragmentation on cyber fraud governance and introduce the lifecycle misalignment perspective (LMP) as a framework for cyber fraud management. Design/methodology/approach The study uses the SPAR-4-SLR protocol to systematically analyse 39 peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2008 and 2024, selected from an initial pool of 899 records. For analytical depth, the study further uses the Theory–Context–Characteristics–Methodology (TCCM) framework as an analytical lens to examine lifecycle-based knowledge development and explore recurring fragmentation across the domain literature. Findings The review demonstrates that cyber fraud research encompasses diverse theoretical, contextual, empirical and methodological perspectives, yet lacks integration across these domains. The cross-dimensional synthesis reveals six recurring forms of fragmentation across the TCCM dimensions, which inform the development of the LMP. Six propositions are derived concerning detection–prevention alignment, technology–behaviour alignment, organisational–systemic alignment, prevention–learning alignment, methodological integration and contextual alignment in lifecycle-oriented cyber fraud governance. Practical implications The proposed framework will help to guide financial institutions, regulators and policymakers in developing more integrated and resilient governance strategies across the cyber fraud management lifecycle. Originality/value This study offers three major contributions. Firstly, it shifts cyber fraud research from stage-specific analysis to an integrated governance perspective. Secondly, it applies the TCCM framework as an analytical lens and develops the LMP from the resulting cross-dimensional synthesis. Lastly, it introduces six research propositions and a structured agenda to support future empirical research on lifecycle-oriented cyber fraud governance.

title: Influence of Mathematics Teachers' Digital Competence on  Students' Learning Outcomes in Secondary Schools in Rivers State,  Nigeria
container-title: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF EDUCATION AND EVALUATION
faa72136da7a7db2e16cc50286f07bda372e731f.abstract: This study investigated the influence of mathematics teachers' digital competence on Senior Secondary School Year Two (SS2) students' learning outcomes in Rivers State, Nigeria. Utilizing a mixed-methods design combining a quasi-experimental pre-test/post-test non-equivalent control group setup with a correlational survey, the study sampled 40 mathematics teachers and 384 SS2 students across 20 registered private secondary schools. Data were collected using the validated Mathematics Teachers' Digital Competence Questionnaire (MTDCQ) and the Mathematics Achievement and Conceptual Understanding Test (MACUT). Analysis using descriptive statistics, ANCOVA, Pearson Correlation, and Linear Regression revealed that while (+30.45) than those in teachers possessed moderate basic digital literacy (Xˉ=3.12), their digital pedagogical integration (Xˉ=2.31) and assessment competencies (Xˉ=2.18) remained low. Students taught with digital tools achieved significantly higher post-test mean scores (68.90±9.15) and mean gains the control group (52.35±10.42; +14.55; F(1,381)=252.38,p<.05,Partial η2=.395). A strong positive correlation was established between teachers' digital competence and student achievement (r=.642, p<.05), while digital tool usage significantly predicted student engagement (R2=.341,p<.05). The study concludes that upgrading teachers' Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) is vital for improving mathematics outcomes, recommending targeted subject-specific training and improved digital infrastructure.

title: Algorithmic cognitive programmes: observing ambient architectures of attention with social systems theory
container-title: Kybernetes
51d2013b2858e0715f8c03247ec8eb58d1d1a814.abstract: Purpose This paper extends Luhmann's concept of programmes – decision premises specifying the conditions under which a system's binary code is operatively assigned – into the domain of algorithmically mediated communication. It conceptualises recommendation systems, ranking algorithms and feedback architectures as ambient cognitive programmes: recursive, probabilistic selectors that perturb the structural coupling between social and psychic systems, and examines the constitutional implications of their opacity and transfunctional reach. Design/methodology/approach The study develops a systemic–cybernetic model grounded in Luhmann's social systems theory and the epistemology of autopoietic cognition, integrating Teubner's theory of societal constitutionalism to address the normative dimensions of algorithmic mediation. Analytical illustrations from Facebook and TikTok contrast two recommendation architectures – affinity-based cascading and behavioural-similarity propagation – to demonstrate how the model applies across distinct platform logics. Findings Algorithmic cognitive programmes operate as meta-programmes that reconfigure multiple forms of social differentiation simultaneously, enacting a binary operational distinction of visibility/invisibility through engagement metrics. Their colonisation of communicative environments – by economic imperatives and, as the analysis argues, by the autonomous logic of technical mediation – becomes a constitutional pathology where its effects cannot be contested or corrected, requiring internal self-limiting mechanisms that render operative selection criteria observable to affected systems. Originality/value The paper advances a novel theoretical category – ambient cognitive programmes – that extends Luhmann's organisational typology by identifying a configuration it does not explicitly address: a purpose programme without a terminal goal state that continuously revises the conditional programmes it governs. It connects this analytical framework to Teubner's societal constitutionalism, proposing constitutional observability as a structural condition for the compatibility between algorithmic regimes and communicative pluralism.

title: A review of predictive maintenance strategies for Industry 5.0: AI, digital twins and human–machine collaboration
container-title: Journal of Quality in Maintenance Engineering
24d188956295cd9e7430988639ed3dfafe01a783.abstract: Purpose The purpose of this article is to provide a comprehensive review of predictive maintenance (PdM) strategies within the emerging Industry 5.0 paradigm, emphasizing the shift from automation-centric maintenance to human-centric, collaborative systems. The study aims to synthesize model-based, data-driven, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled and hybrid PdM approaches, examine the role of key enabling technologies such as digital twins and edge computing and highlight human–machine collaboration in maintenance decision-making. By proposing a unified taxonomy, the article seeks to identify research gaps and guide the development of resilient, sustainable and explainable PdM systems. Design/methodology/approach This study adopts a structured systematic review methodology to analyze PdM strategies in the context of Industry 5.0. Peer-reviewed journal articles, standards and authoritative reports were identified through major scientific databases using predefined keywords related to PdM, condition-based maintenance, AI, digital twins and human–machine collaboration. The selected literature was critically examined and classified based on maintenance approach, enabling technologies, deployment architecture and degree of human involvement. Comparative analysis was employed to identify research gaps, challenges and emerging trends, culminating in the development of a novel taxonomy for Industry 5.0-oriented PdM systems. Findings The review reveals that PdM in Industry 5.0 is evolving toward hybrid frameworks that integrate data-driven intelligence with physics-based models and human expertise. While AI-based approaches improve diagnostic and prognostic accuracy, challenges related to data quality, interpretability and workforce acceptance persist. Digital twins, edge computing and collaborative robots emerge as key enablers for real-time, resilient and human-centric maintenance systems. The analysis highlights a lack of unified frameworks addressing human–machine collaboration and resilience, underscoring the need for explainable, lifecycle-oriented PdM solutions tailored to Industry 5.0 environments. Research limitations/implications This study is limited by its reliance on published literature, which may underrepresent proprietary industrial implementations and emerging practices not yet reported in academic sources. The review does not include empirical validation or quantitative benchmarking of PdM methods, focusing instead on conceptual and methodological synthesis. Nevertheless, the proposed taxonomy and identified research gaps provide a foundation for future empirical studies, experimental validation and large-scale industrial case analyses aimed at developing resilient, human-centric PdM frameworks aligned with Industry 5.0 principles. Practical implications The findings of this review offer practical guidance for industrial practitioners seeking to implement PdM within Industry 5.0 environments. The proposed taxonomy assists decision-makers in selecting appropriate PdM strategies based on system complexity, human involvement and technological readiness. Insights into digital twins, edge computing and human-in-the-loop AI support the design of maintenance systems that enhance reliability, reduce unplanned downtime and improve workforce acceptance. The study also highlights the importance of explainable and collaborative maintenance solutions to facilitate successful adoption in real-world manufacturing settings. Social implications By emphasizing human-centric and collaborative PdM, this study highlights the social impact of Industry 5.0 on the industrial workforce. The integration of human-in-the-loop decision-making and collaborative robots can improve workplace safety, reduce physically demanding tasks and support skill augmentation rather than job displacement. Transparent and explainable maintenance systems foster trust between workers and intelligent technologies, facilitating organizational acceptance and long-term adoption. Ultimately, Industry 5.0-oriented PdM contributes to more inclusive, resilient and sustainable industrial environments that align technological advancement with human well-being. Originality/value This article provides one of the first comprehensive reviews that explicitly situates PdM within the Industry 5.0 paradigm, moving beyond automation-centric perspectives. Its originality lies in the integration of PdM, condition-based maintenance, diagnostics and prognostics through a unified, human-centric lens. The study proposes a novel taxonomy that incorporates digital twins, edge computing and human–robot collaboration, offering a structured foundation for future research. By bridging technological, organizational and human factors, the article delivers both conceptual clarity and practical value for advancing next-generation maintenance systems.

title: Motivated toward digital: relationship of CEO regulatory focus and digital orientation
container-title: Baltic Journal of Management
21d7ce56b2c04a1eb1f0c151001d9e452ac362c1.abstract: Purpose This study examines how CEO regulatory focus relates to a firm's digital orientation, recognizing that pursuing digital opportunities is crucial for competitive advantage. We propose that CEO promotion focus is positively related to digital orientation, while prevention focus is negatively related, and explore how alignment between regulatory focus and the firm's environment (regulatory fit) moderates this relationship. Design/methodology/approach We analyzed S&P 500 firms from 2010 through 2019 using data from Compustat, Execucomp and annual shareholder letters, measured key variables with computer-assisted text analysis and tested hypotheses using generalized estimating equations. Findings The findings show that CEO prevention focus is positively associated with digital orientation, and that the strength of this relationship depends on environmental dynamism and complexity, while promotion focus was found not to be associated with digital orientation nor vary with the environment. Originality/value We extend research on managerial characteristics and digital orientation by examining how CEO goal pursuit motivation, specifically growth (promotion focus) versus security (prevention focus) needs, relates to firm's orientation toward digital opportunities.

title: Material passports for circular built environments: a systematic review of information requirements, digital tools and implementation barriers
container-title: Smart and Sustainable Built Environment
f9455d736d0a6e630d7c67ede3d1625232d357d5.abstract: Purpose Material passports are increasingly presented as instruments for circular construction, yet the specific information requirements, digital infrastructures and implementation barriers that shape their use across building lifecycle stages remain fragmented. This study aims to synthesise the material passport literature and develop an information-centred framework for circular built environments. Design/methodology/approach A systematic literature review was conducted using a structured search, screening and eligibility protocol. The final corpus consists of 51 journal-based studies published between 2018 and 2026. Descriptive analysis, thematic co-word analysis and thematic coding were used to classify information requirements, digital tools, lifecycle stages, circularity functions and implementation barriers. Automated pre-screening was used only to reduce the initial metadata pool; the final corpus was determined through eligibility screening and structured thematic coding. Findings Material passports connect material data with BIM-enabled systems, databases, digital platforms, digital twins, blockchain-based traceability, lifecycle assessment and decision-support tools across the building lifecycle. The dominant implementation barriers concern interoperability, standardisation, platform integration, economic feasibility, stakeholder coordination and regulatory alignment. Originality/value The study contributes by reframing material passports as an information ecosystem for circular built environments. It provides a lifecycle-based mapping of information requirements, digital tools, circularity functions and barriers, and proposes a conceptual framework to support future passport-enabled circular construction research and practice. Unlike studies that examine material passports primarily as building information modelling extensions, circular economy tools or digital product passport templates, this review explains how data requirements, digital processing and implementation conditions interact across lifecycle stages.

7d6247dfa61e32adc43356158a25e010d813960e.abstract: El capítulo relaciona el funcionamiento de la cámara digital con las decisiones técnicas y expresivas que intervienen en la captación de imágenes. Explica la participación del objetivo, el sensor, el procesador y el almacenamiento, y desarrolla el control de la exposición mediante el valor ISO, la apertura del diafragma y la velocidad de obturación. La comparación de sistemas de cámara y las funciones asistidas por inteligencia artificial se vinculan con la elección del equipo y la supervisión de los ajustes automáticos según la intención narrativa.

title: Integrating BIM and material passports to foster circularity in offsite construction: a five-layer digital framework
container-title: International Journal of Building Pathology and Adaptation
0f1f642137bac41288d2f006ec775f79a47fc266.abstract: Purpose Circular economy (CE) integration in offsite construction (OSC) is increasingly recognised as a pathway to reduce waste, carbon emissions and inefficient material practices. However, the digital mechanisms required to operationalise circularity across design, construction and reuse phases in OSC remain fragmented and underdeveloped. Design/methodology/approach This study develops a five-layer digital integration framework that aligns building information modelling (BIM) with material passports (MPs) to support circular workflows. Drawing on a systematic literature review (SLR) of 40 peer-reviewed studies, the framework comprises: (1) Data Input Layer, (2) BIM Platform Layer, (3) Integration Layer, (4) Lifecycle Feedback Layer and (5) Circular Decision Support Layer. Findings The synthesis layer identifies key digital bottlenecks across the five layers, including missing CE metadata, poor interoperability and a lack of lifecycle feedback loops. By embedding circular material intelligence within BIM environments, the framework offers a scalable roadmap for traceability, reuse planning and CE-driven decision-making in OSC. Practical implications The framework provides industry stakeholders with a scalable roadmap to enable material traceability, reuse planning and circular decision-making across the OSC lifecycle. It supports practical alignment with emerging CE policies and market incentives. Originality/value This study contributes a theoretically grounded framework and practical recommendations for advancing digital circular construction. It lays the groundwork for future digital tool development and policy alignment to supports CE adoption in the built environment.

title: Guidelines for assessing lean office maturity in digital environments
container-title: The TQM Journal
3a6702c0e1346d28927e45a77a6745efff6830ac.abstract: Purpose This paper develops a structured and actionable framework of guidelines to assess Lean Office maturity in digital environments, grounded in a sociotechnical systems perspective and organizational learning principles. It examines how digitalization, information security, leadership, and cultural factors jointly shape the evolution of Lean Office systems toward operational excellence and sustainable performance. Design/methodology/approach A three-phase research design was employed, integrating a systematic literature review with a structured content analysis of international standards (ISO 10018, 10010, 10020, 14005, and 27,001), using iterative coding, categorization, and synthesis procedures. Twenty-five practices were identified, consolidated, and refined into ten maturity guidelines organized into three areas: organizational culture, organizational changes and employees, and management. Findings The results show that Lean Office maturity is a dynamic and progressive capability shaped by the interaction among people, management routines, and digital technologies. The study demonstrates that integrating cultural, managerial, and digital practices into a unified maturity architecture provides both a theoretical lens for understanding Lean Office evolution and a practical roadmap for managerial decision-making in digital environments. Practical implications The guidelines provide managers with a clear diagnostic and improvement roadmap, helping them assess readiness, strengthen cultural and leadership foundations, and align digital transformation efforts with Lean Office objectives. The framework supports the transition from isolated improvement actions to coherent and sustainable organizational practices. Originality/value Grounded in Sociotechnical Systems Theory and Dynamic Capabilities Theory, this study conceptualizes Lean Office maturity as a sociotechnical capability by translating international standards into operational maturity architecture. Unlike traditional Lean maturity and Lean 4.0 models focused on tools or technologies, the framework explains how cultural, leadership, change management, digitalization, and information security practices interact to shape Lean Office maturity in digital environments.

title: Generative AI Literacies and Discipline-Specific Knowledge: Preservice Teachers Planning Task-Based L2 Lessons with GenAI
container-title: Digital Studies in Language and Literature
49cfa4edc8a86155f27305dd81b772f6f0a87a1a.abstract: Abstract This study investigates the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to support Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT)-oriented lesson planning in a preservice teacher education context, examining the extent to which LLM use can contribute to the mobilisation of TBLT-related competencies. The case study draws on triangulated data from surveys, interaction logs with the LLM, lesson plans produced by preservice teachers and their reflections. The module required participants to generate a lesson plan with an LLM and to compare the resulting plan with a previously created lesson plan developed without AI support. The analysis focuses on knowledge of TBLT principles and their implementation during lesson planning, and the GenAI competence activated through the interaction with the LLM. The findings reveal considerable variation in how the dyads interacted with the LLM. Some dyads formulated more precise prompts and prompt iterations, provided more contextualised input, engaged more critically with the LLM-generated output, and iteratively refined their lesson plans in ways that appeared more consistent with TBLT principles. The data suggest an association between a stronger conceptual understanding of TBLT and more purposeful interaction with the LLM. This association indicates that disciplinary knowledge may facilitate the effective use of LLMs for TBLT-oriented lesson planning. Rather than replacing pedagogical expertise, LLM use appears to be most productive when preservice teachers are able to critically evaluate and adapt the generated output in light of established TBLT principles.

title: Peningkatan Daya Saing UMKM Disabilitas Kota Bandung: Digital Branding dan Konten Media Sosial

27439c7cabefe9183e57a42184f7e1b647a42d97.abstract: This community service activity aims to strengthen the digital branding capability and social media content management skills of eleven micro-enterprise owners with disabilities at Rumah Kolaborasi, Bandung City, in order to improve the competitiveness of their products. The activity was carried out through preparation, implementation, and evaluation stages, using accessible lectures, demonstrations, guided practice, and personal mentoring by Digital Business students. Materials covered brand identity, product photography using mobile phones, promotional copywriting, and content planning. Evaluation used pre-test and post-test instruments together with observation of concrete outputs for each business unit. The results show an increase in participants’ understanding of brand identity concepts and improvement in the visual quality of their product documentation, along with better managed business social media accounts. These findings indicate that accessible, inclusive digital branding mentoring can improve product competitiveness of micro-enterprises run by persons with disabilities without requiring large capital investment.

title: Developing and Evaluating Digital School Asset Management for Accountability in an Indonesian Island District
container-title: International Journal of Studies in International Education
225331262325aee898fc9f0d5bb423f6bb3ca9e4.abstract: Elementary schools require reliable asset information to account for infrastructure and coordinate district oversight. This study developed and evaluated a digital School Asset Management Information System (SIMA) in Tinangkung, an Indonesian island district. An ADDIE research-and-development process combined baseline interviews and surveys, model design, expert review, pilot testing, and an expanded one-group pretest–posttest evaluation. Four experts judged the model fit for implementation with minor revisions; 30 users completed an 18-item practicality questionnaire; and 14 schools contributed paired accountability measurements. Preliminary responses showed manual records in 10 of 11 schools (90.9%) and no direct district data integration in seven (63.6%). The initial practicality score was 75.51% of the possible total. After implementation, mean data accuracy increased from 74.2% to 98.2%, reporting timeliness from 0.0% to 92.3%, and digital asset traceability from 75.4% to 100.0%. Mean normalized gains were 0.94, 0.92, and 1.00, respectively. Primary paired comparisons were statistically significant at the 5% level. The findings indicate promising short-term administrative improvements associated with a three-axis school–cloud–district system, while the absence of a comparison group prevents exclusive causal attribution. The analysis concerns operational governance indicators, not student achievement, long-term financial savings, cybersecurity assurance, or external audit judgments, none of which were measured directly.

Penerapan Microlearning dalam Meningkatkan Literasi Digital dan Kemampuan Pemrograman: Studi Literatur Review
container-title: BLAZE :  Jurnal Bahasa dan Sastra dalam Pendidikan Linguistik dan Pengembangan
9db59d222b58e78b2828c87c45e1116f490dc4b1.abstract: Microlearning, the delivery of content in small units focused on a single learning goal, is increasingly used to build digital competence, yet evidence on its effects on digital literacy and programming ability has rarely been synthesised together. This study maps intervention characteristics, effectiveness, and implementation challenges. A systematic literature review following PRISMA 2020 covered journal articles, proceedings, and theses from 2016-2026, searched through open academic search on 16 October 2026. Of 48 records assessed, 14 primary studies were included (10 on digital literacy or competence, 4 on programming). All five controlled experimental studies favoured the Microlearning group; pre-post studies without comparison groups showed gains but are weak for causal inference. Recurring features were short single-concept units, interactivity with immediate feedback, and repeated access. Main barriers were infrastructure, teachers’ content-production skills, fragmented attention, and evidence quality. Microlearning appears promising as a complement to, not a replacement for, conventional instruction.

title: PENGUATAN KAPASITAS PROMOSI DIGITAL KELOMPOK SADAR WISATA SENGGARANG MELALUI <i>CONTENT CREATION</i> DAN <i>SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING</i>

7625eb09214ea56c0a0d66fc647d3c51595124c4.abstract: Kelompok Sadar Wisata (Pokdarwis) Senggarang memiliki potensi wisata budaya, sejarah, dan maritim, akan tetapi upaya promosi digital masih sangat minim, dikarenakan banyak faktor seperti terbatasnya keterampilan anggota Pokdarwis dalam pengelolaan media sosial. Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kapasitas promosi di bidang digital dari Pokdarwis melalui content creation dan social media marketing. Kegiatan dilaksanakan melalui beberapa tahapan, yaitu pelatihan, diskusi, praktik, serta evaluasi pemahaman peserta menggunakan pre-test dan post-test. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan adanya peningkatan rata-rata nilai peserta, dari 59,3 pada pre-test yang diisi 20 peserta menjadi 84,7 pada post-test yang diisi oleh 18 peserta, atau meningkat 25,4 poin (42,8%) dengan nilai N-Gain sebesar 0,62 yang termasuk kategori sedang. title: Rancang Bangun Platform Intelligent Digital Marketing Berbasis Business Intelligence Terintegrasi E-Commerce bagi UMKM Lokal Negeri Hatumete
container-title: Natural: Jurnal Pelaksanaan Pengabdian Bergerak bersama Masyarakat.
5d19cbf7eb8e63e038d0d0c057f5550630477bfa.abstract: Digital transformation has become a strategic necessity for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to expand market reach, improve transaction efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making. MSMEs in Negeri Hatumete, Maluku, require an integrated system for marketing, sales, and business performance monitoring. This study aims to design and develop ISLAND-MARKET, a digital marketing platform integrating e-commerce and a Business Intelligence (BI) dashboard. The study employs a mixed-methods approach involving user requirements identification, system architecture design, web-based application development, and planned evaluations of functionality, information accuracy, and usability. The system includes modules for products, categories, orders, customers, payments, shipping, vouchers, sales analytics, and reporting. Implementation results demonstrate an administrator dashboard displaying six key performance indicators: total revenue, total orders, products sold, customer count, active products, and pending orders. The dashboard also provides period filters and sales and revenue visualizations. Integrating e-commerce and descriptive analytics potentially enables more structured business monitoring. However, system effectiveness requires further functional testing, dashboard data verification against database records, and user evaluation using the System Usability Scale (SUS). This study contributes an integrated digital platform design tailored to MSME management needs in archipelagic regions, providing a foundation for developing more sustainable local digital services.

title: Digital and social media marketing: a bibliometric mapping from 2020 to 2025
container-title: Future Business Journal
1efa7acaec91d7cadd0b1697f959622379ed485a.abstract: Abstract Digital and social media marketing is reshaping how firms communicate with consumers, gather market intelligence, manage customer journeys, and build brand relationships. This study followed the PRISMA framework to select relevant Scopus-indexed articles between 2020 and 2025 under the business, management, and accounting subject area, using the search terms “digital marketing” and “social media marketing” in titles, abstracts, and keywords. The search, conducted on 20 February 2026 and restricted to open-access, English-language, final-stage journal articles, yielded 1,054 articles. Performance analysis, citation analysis, author-keyword co-occurrence mapping, an average-publication-year overlay, co-citation analysis, and bibliographic coupling were conducted using VOSviewer. Findings reveal publication growth, particularly during 2024 and 2025. Indonesia was the leading country by publications, whereas the UK was the most influential country by citations. Additionally, the “Journal of Business Research” is the most influential, while “Cogent Business & Management” is the most productive journal; the most-cited document is “Setting the future of digital and social media marketing research: Perspectives and research propositions,” with 1,806 citations, produced by “International Journal of Information Management.” Four of the ten prominent authors published six papers each, including Saura, J.R., and Huertas-Garcia, R., both affiliated with Spanish institutions. Keyword mapping identifies digital marketing, social media marketing, social media, consumer behavior, marketing, and purchase intention as central themes. This study clarifies the post-2020 knowledge structure of the open-access segment of this literature, proposes that digital and social media marketing forms a single domain, and identifies future research directions for marketing ecosystems.

title: Potential mediating role of maternal self-efficacy in the association between perceived social support and postpartum fatigue: a cross-sectional study
container-title: BMC Pregnancy and Childbirth
0fc1ea6531503b7927e31de638c161a07fca8d96.abstract: Abstract Background Postpartum fatigue is a common yet underrecognized condition affecting maternal well-being and caregiving capacity. However, the mechanisms linking social support to postpartum fatigue remain unclear. This study aimed to examine the potential mediating role of maternal self-efficacy in the association between perceived social support and postpartum fatigue. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted at eight family health centres in Erzincan, Türkiye, between May 5 and November 5, 2023. Centres were purposively selected, with proportional allocation targets across the selected centres; within centres, eligible women who agreed to participate were recruited by convenience. Data were collected from 313 women at 4–6 weeks postpartum using the Fatigue Assessment Scale, Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support, and Perceived Maternal Parenting Self-Efficacy Scale. Pearson correlations and PROCESS Model 4 were used. Regression inference used HC3 standard errors; indirect associations were assessed using 5,000 percentile bootstrap resamples. Results Perceived social support was positively correlated with maternal self-efficacy (r = 0.630) and negatively correlated with postpartum fatigue (r = −0.454); maternal self-efficacy was negatively correlated with fatigue (r = −0.377; all p < 0.01). In the regression models, social support was positively associated with self-efficacy (B = 0.3500, p < 0.001), and self-efficacy was negatively associated with fatigue after accounting for social support (B = −0.1251, p = 0.0346). The direct association between social support and fatigue remained significant (B = −0.1663, p < 0.001). The indirect association through self-efficacy was −0.0438 (95% bootstrap CI [ − 0.0839, −0.0030]). The total association was −0.2100 ( p < 0.001). Conclusions An indirect association consistent with the proposed mediation model was observed. The cross-sectional design does not establish temporal ordering or causal mediation. Prospective and interventional studies are needed to test whether changes in social support and maternal self-efficacy are followed by changes in postpartum fatigue.

title: AMBIENTE DIGITAL NA EDUCAÇÃO CONTEMPORÂNEA: POTENCIALIDADES, DESAFIOS E IMPLICAÇÕES PEDAGÓGICAS
container-title: Revista Tópicos
1d75ec21093bc5925816f8622d6c0b07f873fa27.abstract: Este artigo tem como objetivo investigar de que forma o ambiente digital vem transformando as práticas educacionais, destacando as vantagens, benefícios e riscos envolvidos na integração das Tecnologias Digitais de Informação e Comunicação (TDIC) ao contexto escolar. Para isso, adotou-se a metodologia de pesquisa bibliográfica. O avanço das TDCIs a tem promovido mudanças profundas no campo educacional, redefinindo não apenas os instrumentos pedagógicos, mas também a forma como os sujeitos se relacionam com o conhecimento. A presença crescente das tecnologias no cotidiano escolar favorece práticas mais dinâmicas, personalizadas e interativas, ao mesmo tempo em que impõe desafios importantes, como a proteção de dados, a exclusão digital e a necessidade de formação docente contínua. Diante desse contexto, é essencial refletir sobre os impactos do ambiente digital na educação, equilibrando seus benefícios e riscos, especialmente no que diz respeito à equidade, à qualidade e à intenção pedagógica. O tema se insere no modelo educacional atual, que demanda não só o uso de tecnologias, mas a ressignificação das práticas docentes frente às mudanças culturais e tecnológicas. Conclui-se que o ambiente digital oferece contribuições significativas para a educação, ao ampliar possibilidades pedagógicas, personalizar aprendizagens e dinamizar o acesso ao conhecimento. No entanto, seus riscos exigem atenção, especialmente quanto à privacidade de dados, exclusão digital e uso descontextualizado das tecnologias. Assim, é indispensável que a incorporação das TDIC seja orientada por princípios pedagógicos sólidos, formação docente contínua e políticas públicas que promovam uma educação crítica, ética e inclusiva.

title: Hubungan Dukungan Keluarga dan School Well-Being terhadap Minat Belajar Siswa Sekolah Dasar di Era Digital

abb59a1014f51d9c3fa631503e4df13d7f9c23a7.abstract: Learning interest is a crucial factor for academic success but faces challenges from technological exposure in the digital era. This study aims to analyze the relationship between family support, school well-being, and the learning interest of upper-grade elementary school students. A quantitative correlational design involved 404 students selected via stratified random sampling in Cibinong District, Bogor. Data from Likert-scale questionnaires were analyzed using Pearson correlation and multiple linear regression. Findings revealed a significant positive relationship between family support and learning interest (r = 0.528, p < 0.001), characterized by high instrumental but low emotional support. Furthermore, a strong positive relationship exists between school well-being and learning interest (r = 0.696, p < 0.001). Jointly, both variables significantly predicted learning interest (F = 214.0, p < 0.001), contributing 51.6% to the variance, with school well-being exerting a greater influence. These results imply that optimizing student engagement requires synergistic educational strategies involving digital parenting and a positive school climate.

title: Analisis Yuridis Perlindungan Hukum Konsumen Lansia dalam Perjanjian Baku Digital pada Transaksi Elektronik di Indonesia
container-title: Jurnal Hukum Indonesia
fba037b896fc9c2651720640887d57cd6de6e446.abstract: Perjanjian baku digital pada layanan Shopee PayLater menempatkan konsumen lansia pada posisi rentan melalui mekanisme clickwrap agreement yang tidak memberi ruang negosiasi, sementara penelitian terdahulu belum menghubungkan kerentanan lansia dengan kekaburan norma perjanjian baku digital melalui teori kekaburan hukum (vagueness theory). Penelitian hukum normatif ini menggunakan pendekatan perundang-undangan, konseptual, kasus, dan perbandingan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Pasal 18 Undang-Undang Nomor 8 Tahun 1999 tentang Perlindungan Konsumen dan Undang-Undang Nomor 11 Tahun 2008 tentang Informasi dan Transaksi Elektronik beserta perubahannya sesungguhnya telah mengatur klausula baku, tetapi rumusannya kabur sehingga belum menjangkau mekanisme clickwrap, browsewrap, sign-in wrap, dan scroll-wrap agreement. Kekaburan tersebut tercermin dalam Putusan Pengadilan Tinggi Medan Nomor 567/Pdt/2019/PT MDN, yang menilai keterikatan kontrak elektronik semata-mata dari tindakan transaksi tanpa menguji pemahaman substantif konsumen. Kondisi ini berpotensi terulang pada sengketa konsumen lansia pengguna Shopee PayLater. Penelitian ini menemukan tiga bentuk kerentanan konsumen lansia: ketiadaan pengakuan normatif, kerentanan terhadap dark patterns, dan lemahnya pengawasan ex ante. Kebaruan penelitian terletak pada pengujian kekaburan Pasal 18 UUPK terhadap keempat mekanisme perjanjian baku digital sekaligus serta harmonisasi UU ITE, PP Nomor 71 Tahun 2019, Perpres Nomor 82 Tahun 2023, POJK Nomor 22 Tahun 2023, dan UU PDP sebagai kerangka regulasi utama, dengan UUPK sebagai regulasi pendukung.
